Today that’s informally covered by the MD/ Founder, which caps how much the business can grow and means things slip during busy periods. Your role will be to take this over, own key accounts, and have impact across the whole business. Success looks like retaining our customers, successfully expanding and renewing accounts, and collaborating tightly with Operations, Strategy, and Sales to further our continuous improvement and growth. You will report directly to the MD/ Founder and be expected to contribute as a senior leader in the team. Supporting signals will be seen in the day-to-day: clients are not chasing us to find out what’s happening, call prep and calls have a clear story running through the deck that you own, you are nudging Operations and Strategy to ensure the voice of the customer is heard internally; and expansions, case studies, and referrals happen because someone owns them.   What you'd do Own the story for each client. What they bought, what they want, what we've done, what's next -- and tell it clearly. The team preps the data and analysis; you make it land. You own the narrative in client decks and calls. Run the communication rhythm. At the start of each week, quick updates to clients via Slack (what we did, what’s next, what’s blocked, performance highlights); ad-hoc comms throughout the week via email and Slack, and either monthly or fortnightly calls depending on the client.  Understand our clients’ businesses so you can contribute and expand. Ellipsis has an extremely consultative sales process and our clients trust us as experts. In many instances, we’re brought in to do “GEO” but end up as a strategic marketing partner. This creates expansion opportunities which you can pursue as long as you understand their business and where we can contribute more -- expansion and adding value go hand-in-hand and we build for the long-term success of the business. Be curious about AI search and strategy. AI search is changing quickly and Ellipsis is leading that change. We are constantly producing new research, looking at data, and optimizing our approach. You will work with a Strategy Lead for each account (and the Head of Strategy across the business) but need to be curious, data literate, and capable of deeply understanding what we’re doing and why -- which will let you confidently hold the room when discussing strategy, and advocate for the client’s needs effectively. Front the key relationships. For the top ~8-10 accounts, you attend the calls and run the relationship. For the rest, you own the story, ensure internal alignment, and step in on renewals, risk, or expansion (Content Managers front the regular calls). Own renewals and expansions. Spot and shape upsell opportunities, run the renewal conversations, chase case-study permissions and referrals. You’ll need to both be able to smell adjacent opportunities (we are currently one of the few agencies that can do strategy, copy, and design for a “GEO friendly website”, but don’t advertise this enough!) and guide renewals/expansions (which are always inherently tied to strategy and what more we can do for the customer). Advocate for the client internally. When work is late or off-brief, you say so and chase it. You represent what the client actually asked for, even when that's uncomfortable. Report and contribute to planning internally. You’ll join (and lead part of) the Monday morning pipeline and accounts review meeting, where we plan upcoming business and assess the state of renewals and expansion opportunities with existing accounts. You’ll work closely with Operations to ensure we have the right capacity at the right time, and work closely with Sales to ensure you understand incoming prospects and are ready to advocate for their needs internally from day one.   What this role is not Not a project manager or a status-updater. Not operations -- you flag delivery problems, the ops lead fixes processes. Not new-business sales -- acquisition is covered.   Requirements You’ll have owned complex and commercially important client relationships. In other UK agencies this is typically a mid-to-senior “Accounts Director” or exceptional “Senior Accounts Manager” role but we’re open to other roles, industries, and experiences. Marketing or SEO agency experience is probably helpful. You will need to become fluent enough in SEO and AI search to hold the room with a technical, sceptical client -- you don't produce the analysis, but you can defend it; but we’re happy for you to pick this up quickly on the job. You should be commercially confident: happy to run a renewal and ask for the expansion. Warm with clients, firm internally.   Compensation £60-65k There is no individual commission. Renewals and expansions at Ellipsis are team outcomes: Strategy, Content, Design and Operations create the value, while the Accounts Lead ensures clients understand it and leads the commercial conversation. We therefore pay a strong fixed salary and assess success through the long-term retention, health and growth of the client book.   First 90 days Shadow the founder on the key accounts, then take them over one by one. Ship the onboarding protocol and monthly update rhythm. Baseline the retention numbers. By day 90, you own the top relationships and the founder attends client calls by exception only. To be successful at Ellipsis, you need to be able to think quickly from first principles, capable of executing quickly, and driven to succeed. Whilst we’re 8 years old, we operate like a startup. The team -- a lot of whom have been with us a long time -- will tell you this is a place to learn quickly, progress quickly, and do your best work. Your capability matters a lot more to us than your experience, and we would recommend you tailor your application with this in mind. We want to hear from you rather than ChatGPT. Please keep this in mind in particular with the screening questions.   Benefits This is a full-time, 100% remote role (UK/EU based). Work from home, or the beach! We have a lot of clients in the US and California, so you'll need to be available for client and new business calls in the 5-7pm UK slot a couple of days a week (generally don't go later than this, but you'll need to be available as needed). 28 days of paid holiday An additional 1 paid holiday day a year with each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 5 additional days 4-day work week, once a month (instead of local bank holidays) Genuinely flexible working, although noting the meeting schedule requirements above Regular team retreats; last was Istanbul, previously in Edinburgh, Oxford, Madrid, and Budapest Enhanced maternity/paternity leave, and sick pay   The application process It's important we find the best candidate for this position, and our selection process will reflect this. At the heart of every unforgettable LEGO® experience is a seamless connection between people, processes, and technology — and that's where you come in. - *this is your chance to make an impact that truly stacks up!*

The **Senior Technical Program Manager** (TPM) will be a key player in driving high-quality delivery across multi-team, cross-functional programs within the 'Reimagine and Elevate How We Work' (Re-Elevate) initiative. We're reimagining our Digital Product Delivery Lifecycle with AI integration, and you'll be at the forefront. Collaborating closely with Engineering, Product, PPC and external partners, you'll create clarity, foster alignment, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure our transformation progresses smoothly and effectively across teams.
* **Own the day-to-day orchestration** and delivery of a major Re‐Elevate workstream (e.g. Technology, People, Change Management), ensuring outcomes are clear, measurable and aligned to overall programme objectives.
* **Translate strategic direction and operating-model decisions into executable plans**, sequencing work across teams and ensuring progress towards agreed transformation outcomes.

* **Partner with the Re‐Elevate Program Team, Workstream Leads, and fellow TPMs** to define shared goals, milestones, and cross‐workstream expectations.
* **Create transparency across risks and dependencies** ensuring issues are surfaced and mitigated early.
* **Maintain high‐quality program plans**, including transformation roadmaps, dependency maps, delivery milestones and adoption / landing strategies
* **Facilitate alignment across cross‐functional teams**, ensuring blockers are removed quickly and decision paths are clear.
* **Coordinate readiness and adoption activities across DT clusters,** ensuring new operating‐model process, roles & responsibilities are understood, embraced, and embedded consistently.
* **Model excellent collaboration, structure, and delivery discipline**, uplifting TPM craft standards across DT.

A core team is being brought together across key program workstreams, focusing on: digital operating-model, technology, people and change. Each area will have a dedicated TPM, working closely with the workstream teams, Digital leaders and the broader DT team as the work develops.
In Re‐Elevate, Senior TPMs are transformation orchestrators who bring structure, clarity, and disciplined coordination to complex operating‐model change. This won’t have direct line management responsibilities but will lead a major workstream (for example Technology, People, Change Management) and will influence across Product, Engineering and DT - reducing ambiguity, aligning stakeholders, sequencing change, and ensuring the transformation progresses coherently across multiple teams.
This role can be based either at LEGO® Campus in Billund, LEGO® Copenhagen Hub or our LEGO® London Hub. The work environment is exciting, inspiring, flexible, - *and we like to have fun along the way!*

The preferred candidate will be instrumental in guiding teams through transformative changes in roles, rhythms, governance, and ways of working as we adopt a new operating model. * **Implementing the Digital Thread:** Developing software that transforms fragmented data from disparate sources into a unified, ontology-driven Knowledge Graph.

* **Solving Distributed Interoperability:** Creating mechanisms that allow tenuously connected environments and partners to contribute to a shared semantic representation without requiring rigid, point-to-point tool integration.
* **Driving Strategic Adoption:** Contributing to the overall strategy for the wider adoption of Knowledge Graphs and semantic technologies across the business to solve complex data challenges.
* **Ensuring Digital Rigour:** Implementing the configuration control and concurrency models that ensure the Digital Thread remains a reliable, authoritative source of truth at scale.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key implementer of our digital engineering construct. You will move beyond "glue code" to build a high-abstraction layer based on semantic web principles.

* Develop and maintain the software implementation of the Digital Thread using the **Semantic Web stack** (e.g., RDF, OWL, SPARQL).
* Build and optimise the graph databases and triple stores that house the engineering relationships and enrichments.
* Implement the logic that allows for the "enrichment" of data as it moves through the thread, adding semantic value and context.

**Concurrency & Configuration Control**
* Architect and implement the versioning and configuration control mechanisms for the Digital Thread graph, ensuring that changes are traceable and concurrent access is managed.
* Develop software patterns that allow the graph to remain performant and consistent across a large, distributed programme.

Great science regularly stalls in the clinic, not because the science is wrong, but because the company behind it lacks the capital, infrastructure, or focus to take it all the way through. Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients.

Verisk is a global leader in data, analytics and technology, helping organisations make better decisions in some of the world's most complex and critical industries. Verisk, **Specialty Business Solutions (SBS)** provides technology and business solutions to the specialty insurance market. Our work sits at the heart of a sector where better data, smarter technology and stronger collaboration can make a real difference. We're now looking for an experienced Head of Account Management / Director of Account Management to lead and shape our Account Management function. This is a senior leadership role with genuine ownership. You'll set the direction for how SBS manages and grows its customer relationships, while leading a talented team of Account Managers You'll have the opportunity to influence both the customer experience and the commercial performance of the business – creating an account management organisation that is structured, consistent, commercially strong and genuinely focused on customer outcomes.
**Why this role?** This isn't simply a role managing a portfolio of accounts. You'll have the scope to shape the Account Management strategy and operating model across SBS, establish the standards and ways of working that underpin the function, and build a high-performance culture where people know what's expected of them and have the support to succeed. You'll also operate at senior level across the wider Commercial organisation, partnering closely with Sales, Product, Service Delivery, Support, Professional Services and Marketing. The opportunity is particularly suited to someone who enjoys balancing people leadership, customer advocacy and commercial performance – and who wants to leave a lasting mark on how a function operates.
## Responsibilities
**What you'll be responsible for** **Lead and develop a high-performing team** * You'll lead, coach and develop a team of highly experienced Account Managers
* You'll create clarity around objectives, expectations and performance, establish strong coaching and development rhythms, and build a culture centred on accountability, collaboration, customer outcomes and continuous improvement.
* You'll also play an important role in attracting and retaining great talent, developing future leaders and creating meaningful opportunities for progression.
**Shape our Account Management strategy** * You'll define and execute the SBS Account Management strategy and operating model, ensuring our approach to customers is consistent, disciplined and commercially focused.
* You'll establish effective account segmentation and engagement models, strengthen account planning and oversee executive sponsorship and senior stakeholder engagement across priority clients.
* As a senior escalation point, you'll also help navigate complex customer issues and retention risks, while ensuring the voice of the customer is heard in wider Commercial and business planning.
**Own customer retention and growth** * You'll have clear ownership of the overall retention, renewal and growth performance of the managed account portfolio.
* Working closely with Senior leadership, you'll ensure renewal planning is proactive and that opportunities for expansion, cross-sell and upsell are identified and progressed effectively.
* You'll bring together customer insight, account health, commercial performance and market intelligence to identify both risks and opportunities – ensuring teams are focused not just on revenue, but on delivering genuine long-term customer value.
**Drive operational excellence** * You'll establish the governance, processes and operating rhythms that enable the Account Management organisation to perform at its best.
* That includes strengthening account planning, customer health measures, reporting and renewal processes, while identifying opportunities to simplify, standardise or automate how the team works.
* You'll bring structure and visibility to customer risks, actions and opportunities, ensuring issues have clear ownership and are actively managed.

We're looking for a commercially minded people leader who can combine strategic thinking with strong operational execution. With a continuous improvement mindset. * Significant experience leading, coaching and developing high-performing customer-facing teams.
* A strong track record of people leadership, including performance management, coaching, development and conflict resolution.
* Experience of the specialty insurance market, London Market operations or the wider insurance ecosystem would be highly advantageous.
* The gravitas and executive presence to influence confidently at all levels of an organisation.
* Strong commercial acumen across customer value, retention, renewals and account growth.
* Experience designing, implementing or improving account management operating models, governance and performance routines.
* Excellent organisation and planning skills, with the ability to turn strategy into structured execution.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to simplify complex issues and give teams clear direction.

**Role Purpose**
The Oracle Fusion HCM & Payroll Data Migration Lead is responsible for leading and executing the end-to-end data migration lifecycle for Oracle Fusion implementations. The role works closely with customer data teams, business stakeholders and HCM/Payroll functional consultants to define what data is required, how legacy data must be extracted, how it maps to Oracle Fusion, and how it is transformed, loaded, reconciled and validated.
**This is a hands-on delivery role, not a coordination-only position.** The successful candidate is expected to personally create and review migration files, perform Oracle Fusion data loads, analyse load failures, correct and reload data, develop reconciliation outputs, investigate data quality issues and provide clear explanations and recommendations to both customer and project teams.
**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Data Migration Planning and Cycle Leadership**
* Own and drive the data migration workstream across mock migrations, testing cycles, cutover rehearsals and production migration.
* Create and maintain detailed data migration plans covering extraction, mapping, transformation, file preparation, load, validation, reconciliation, defect resolution and rework.
* Define migration milestones, dependencies, entry/exit criteria, ownership and delivery checkpoints for each data object.
* Track migration progress, risks, data defects, decisions and actions, escalating issues that could impact the wider implementation plan.
* Coordinate with programme, customer, functional, technical, testing and business teams while retaining direct ownership of migration delivery.
**2. Customer Extraction Requirements and Legacy Data Analysis**
* Work closely with customer data/extraction teams to define the exact data required from the legacy system for each Oracle Fusion object.
* Translate Oracle Fusion functional and technical requirements into clear legacy extraction specifications, including required fields, selection criteria, effective dating, historical data rules, filters, defaults and valid values.
* Review customer-generated extracts for completeness, structure, data quality and fitness for migration before transformation and load activities begin.
* Analyse source data to identify duplicates, missing mandatory values, invalid dates, broken relationships, inconsistent codes, referential integrity issues and other migration risks.
* Provide actionable feedback to the customer on extraction issues and support iterative correction of source extracts.
**3. Legacy-to-Fusion Mapping and Migration Design**
* Create, maintain and mature mapping documents that establish field-level and value-level mappings between legacy systems and Oracle Fusion.
* Document source fields, Fusion target attributes, transformation rules, defaulting logic, lookup/value mappings, effective-date handling, derivation logic and business rules.
* Work with HCM and Payroll functional consultants to confirm target configuration, mandatory attributes, business rules, reference data and downstream dependencies.
* Ensure changes agreed during migration cycles, defect resolution or functional design discussions are reflected in migration mapping and transformation documentation.
* Identify gaps where legacy data cannot directly support Fusion requirements and define pragmatic transformation, cleansing or defaulting approaches with the relevant stakeholders.
**4. Hands-on Data Preparation, Transformation and Oracle Fusion Loading**
* Prepare Oracle Fusion migration templates and load-ready files from customer-provided legacy extracts.
* Perform data manipulation, transformation, enrichment, formatting and validation using SQL, Excel and other suitable analytical or data-processing tools.
* Create and execute HCM Data Loader (HDL) files and, where appropriate, HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader (HSDL) or other Oracle-supported loading mechanisms.
* Manage load sequencing and dependencies between related HCM and Payroll objects to ensure data is loaded in the correct order.
* Execute loads in Oracle Fusion, review load status and logs, identify failed records, investigate root causes, correct data or file structures and perform re-loads until agreed acceptance criteria are achieved.
* Differentiate between source-data, mapping, transformation, configuration, environment and load-mechanism issues and route or resolve them appropriately.
* Provide clear technical and business justification for rejected or failed records and recommend the required corrective action.
**5. Reconciliation, Validation and Data Quality Assurance**
* Develop, modify and execute reconciliation reports comparing source data, prepared migration files and successfully loaded Oracle Fusion data.
* Use SQL and Oracle Fusion reporting tools such as BI Publisher and OTBI to validate migrated data and identify variances.
* Create object-level validation reports covering record counts, key totals, critical attributes, balances, relationships and other business-significant measures.
* Perform detailed analytical review of migration results rather than relying only on load success percentages.
* Investigate reconciliation differences, identify root causes and drive corrective action through source correction, transformation changes, configuration updates or reload.
* Support business validation by supplying clear reports, exception lists, evidence and explanations that enable customer sign-off.
**6. Functional, Business and Technical Collaboration**
* Partner with Oracle Fusion HCM and Payroll functional consultants to understand configuration, statutory/legislative requirements, functional dependencies and object-specific migration requirements.
* Translate functional requirements into data requirements that customer extraction teams can understand and implement.
* Work directly with business users to clarify legacy data meaning, validate transformation assumptions and resolve data exceptions.
* Collaborate with reporting, integration, security and technical teams where migrated data affects downstream processes or reconciliation.
* Act as the primary data migration point of contact for assigned HCM/Payroll areas and provide confident, evidence-based updates to stakeholders.
**7. Migration Governance and Continuous Improvement**
* Maintain clear auditability of migration rules, mapping decisions, file versions, load results, reconciliation evidence and outstanding exceptions.
* Establish repeatable migration processes, templates, checklists and quality controls across migration cycles.
* Perform root-cause analysis on recurring migration issues and introduce preventative controls for subsequent cycles.
* Support cutover planning by defining final extraction windows, load sequence, estimated processing activities, reconciliation steps and business sign-off requirements.
* Contribute to migration closure reporting, lessons learned and transition of migration knowledge into support or BAU teams where required.

* Previously worked in a project’s related role

* Strong verbal and written communication skills

As pressures continue to grow, so does the need for evidence to underpin the complex decision-making required to achieve government's vision of clean, healthy, safe, productive and biologically diverse seas, managed to meet the long-term needs of people and nature. NatureScot has a key role to play in the development, interpretation and mobilisation of the evidence-base that informs our statutory advice, including in relation to Priority Marine Features (PMFs) and the designation and management of Marine Protected Areas (MPAs).
Focusing on the management and mobilisation of marine biodiversity data, the successful candidate will work closely within our team of existing marine specialists, and a range of partner organisations to help NatureScot deliver the transformation required to ensure a nature-rich future with sustainable use of our seas and land. This post would suit someone with a background in data management with a good attention to detail and an affinity for marine nature conservation.
NatureScot collects and holds significant amounts of marine environmental data, and we also rely on data collected and held by others to carry out our work. We need to ensure that we can obtain the right data to support our business needs, that we collect it in the right way and that we manage and use it as effectively as possible.
There will be opportunities to inspire and engage with stakeholders to collectively influence and take forwards the marine biodiversity data management remit in Scotland, inputting to projects and partnerships aimed at developing knowledge and co-operation in key areas within our remit. # Senior Safety Consultant
**Why Adelard?**
Adelard is a place for people who like thinking carefully about difficult systems.
We work on problems where the answer is not always “follow the process”. Standards matter, but so do evidence, context, engineering judgement and clarity of thought. Our clients come to us because they need independent advice they can understand and trust.
You will work with experienced specialists, contribute to meaningful projects, and develop your ability to assess, explain and defend technical positions in critical domains.
As part of NCC Group, Adelard offers the opportunity to work within a specialist technical consultancy while benefiting from the reach and support of a larger organisation.
**Work On Systems Where Getting It Right Matters**
Adelard helps organisations understand, justify and improve the safety, security and trustworthiness of critical computer-based systems.
We undertake research into engineering assurance methods, exploring how safety standards can be applied effectively in new contexts and where existing guidance requires careful interpretation. This research helps shape the application of standards in certain industries, contributing to the wider development of safety engineering as a practice.
Our work sits at the point where engineering evidence, risk, assurance and judgement meet. We work with clients in sectors such as nuclear, defence, medical, rail, air traffic control, finance and critical infrastructure. The systems we assess are often complex, software-intensive and important enough that vague assurance is not good enough.
We are looking for a Senior Safety Consultant who enjoys difficult technical questions.
Questions such as:
* Does this evidence really support the safety claim being made?
* Has the system behaviour been understood well enough?
* Are the assumptions valid?
* Is the argument convincing, or merely compliant-looking?
* What would a proportionate, defensible engineering position look like?
* How can we explain the issue clearly enough that the client can act on it?
This role would suit someone who likes moving between detail and judgement: reading technical evidence, understanding system behaviour, challenging weak arguments, applying standards intelligently, and helping clients make better decisions about critical systems.
## Key Responsibilities
You will work on varied consultancy projects involving safety-critical and security-relevant systems.
Your work may include:
* Reviewing software, system designs, test evidence, analysis results, assurance cases and safety arguments.
* Assessing whether critical systems have been adequately engineered, analysed and justified.
* Supporting hazard analysis, risk assessment, independent review and compliance assessment.
* Applying standards and regulations in a thoughtful, proportionate way.
* Developing clear technical positions on complex or ambiguous evidence.
* Research into the application of safety standards to low complexity and low criticality product developments.
* Writing reports that are rigorous, readable and useful.
* Explaining findings to clients, project teams and senior stakeholders.
* Using analysis techniques such as static analysis, dynamic analysis, model checking, formal methods, testing or modelling where appropriate.
* Developing scripts, tools, models or analysis approaches to support the work.
* Working with colleagues across safety, security, software, systems engineering, formal methods and assurance.
* Supporting the development of less experienced consultants.
The work is varied. One project might involve reviewing a safety case. Another might involve examining software analysis results. Another might require helping a client interpret a standard, understand a technical risk, or decide what evidence is needed to justify a claim.
We do not expect you to arrive knowing everything. We do expect you to be technically curious, careful in your reasoning, and willing to learn.
## Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
The best people in this role are not just technically competent. They are thoughtful, clear and constructively sceptical.
They can read a document and notice the claim that does not quite follow. They can look at a test result and ask what it proves, what it does not prove, and what assumption is hiding underneath it. They can disagree without grandstanding. They can give advice that is technically defensible and practically useful.
You should be able to:
* Understand how computer-based systems are designed, implemented, tested and assured.
* Interpret complex technical material.
* Identify weak evidence, unsupported claims and unclear reasoning.
* Form independent, evidence-based opinions.
* Explain your thinking clearly in writing and in discussion.
* Work pragmatically without losing technical integrity.
* Move between system-level concerns and low-level technical detail.
* Handle several projects or workstreams at once.
* Build trust with clients and colleagues.
* Contribute to a team of specialists with different areas of expertise.
You may have a background in software engineering, systems engineering, safety engineering, assurance, formal methods, electronics, mathematics, physics or another technical discipline.
Experience in any of the following would be useful:
* Safety-critical, mission-critical or high-integrity systems.
* Embedded software, software assurance or systems engineering.
* Safety assessment, hazard analysis, independent review or assurance cases.
* Static analysis, formal methods, model checking, verification or validation.
* Standards such as IEC 61508, ISO 26262, DO-178C, EN 50128, IEC 62304 or related frameworks.
* Regulated sectors such as nuclear, defence, rail, aerospace, medical devices, automotive, finance, air traffic control or critical infrastructure.
* Safety and security co-engineering.
* Tool development, scripting, modelling or automation.
You do not need experience in all these areas. A strong technical foundation, good judgement and the ability to learn are more important than a perfect keyword match. **Clearance and Travel**

**Role Overview**
This is a hybrid role based in our Cork office.
As a Staff Engineer on NETGEAR’s AI Platform and Enablement team, you will play a strategic and highly impactful role in shaping how AI is built into the fabric of the whole company: engineering teams, business units and corporate functions alike. This position is designed for a deeply experienced technical leader who thrives at the intersection of AI infrastructure, developer enablement and business enablement.
You will own three interconnected areas of ownership. First, you will help build and operate the core AI and LLM platform: model routing, evaluation, and the shared tooling that lets teams across NETGEAR build reliably on top of large language models. Second, you will scale the use of coding agents and assistants across engineering, raising AI fluency and the bar on how we ship software. Third, and equally important, you will extend AI enablement beyond engineering and into business functions — finding the workflows worth automating and building them.
That third mandate is not a side project. A meaningful share of NETGEAR’s near-term AI value sits in business process, not product code, and this role is expected to have organisation-wide impact. Much of the work will resemble the enablement currently being driven for non-technical teams, scaled up and made repeatable.
With significant autonomy, you will own delivery of key technical initiatives aligned with organisational goals and directly influence the short and medium-term success of NETGEAR’s AI strategy.
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI and LLM Platform Infrastructure**
* Design, build, and operate the shared AI platform layer: model routing and fallback strategies, API gateway patterns, rate limiting, and multi-provider abstraction (Anthropic, OpenAI, and others as needed).
* Own cost and usage optimisation across the organisation’s AI spend, covering model selection, prompt and context efficiency, caching, and session-level cost controls.
* Build evaluation, observability, and monitoring for LLM-powered features and agents, including quality regression detection and usage analytics.
* Define architecture and standards for secure, scalable integration of AI capabilities into product and internal systems, including authentication, data handling, and compliance considerations.
**Engineering AI Enablement**
* Drive adoption and effective use of AI coding agents and assistants (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) across engineering teams.
* Build internal tooling, guardrails, and workflows (agentic SDLC patterns, managed agents, review and QA processes) that let engineers safely delegate more work to AI.
* Establish best practices, documentation, and training that raise the AI fluency of the wider engineering organisation.
**Business and Functional Enablement**
* Partner directly with business units and corporate functions (Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, Sales, People, Legal) to identify high-value AI opportunities in their day-to-day work.
* Sit with functional teams, map how their processes actually run today, and simplify before automating: strip out steps that exist only for historical reasons rather than encoding them into an agent.
* Design and deliver AI solutions for non-technical users, including skills, agents, connectors and internal applications that people without an engineering background can adopt and trust.
* Build the enablement layer that makes this repeatable: reusable patterns, templates, onboarding material, office hours, and a community of practice across functions.
* Translate fluently in both directions - turning business problems into technical designs and explaining technical constraints and risks in language a functional leader can act on.
**Technical Leadership and Collaboration**
* Reporting directly to the AI Platform Engineering Director, working with cross-functional teams to align technical execution with NETGEAR’s AI strategy.
* Own delivery of end-to-end initiatives that bridge platform infrastructure, developer tooling, business process and product engineering.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and system debugging across multiple layers of the platform.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to engineers and functional champions working with AI tools and platform services, nurturing a culture of technical excellence and responsible AI use.

###### Job summary:
The Head of Data is responsible for Opera’s core data capability – owning the data architecture, models, integrations, analytics, and reporting estate across the Group. Working closely with Infrastructure, Business Applications, Security, and the Data Protection Officer, the Head of Data translates data strategy into practical delivery – building the platforms, integrations, and reporting capability that support day-to-day operations, regulatory obligations, and the Group’s evolving AI ambitions. * Horizon-scan for emerging data trends, technologies, and opportunities that could deliver business value.

* Support the service desk’s performance reporting needs and provide data for IT management information.

* Own and manage key data lifecycle processes, including data ingestion, transformation, storage, archiving, and retirement.
* Establish and enforce data quality standards, lineage documentation, and governance practices.
* Work with the Data Protection Officer to ensure that the processing and storage of data is compliant with data protection legislation across all Group jurisdictions.
* Work with the Head of Security to ensure data practices meet security and compliance requirements.
* Own all associated data software and products, managing licences, vendors, and roadmap alignment.

* Act as the primary IT contact for business stakeholders with data needs, translating requirements into deliverable, scalable solutions.

Personal data is all information that can be directly or indirectly linked to a living, physical person. Examples of personal data are: name, e-mail address, telephone number and IP address. Processing of personal data is any automated use of personal data - such as collecting, creating, analyzing, sharing, and deleting personal data.
There are laws and regulations on how companies may process personal data, so-called data protection laws. Different data protection laws apply to different types of use of personal data, and in different parts of the world. An example of a data protection law that is relevant for our use of your personal data, as described in this privacy policy, is the EU Data Protection Regulation (2016/679, "GDPR").
Most obligations under the GDPR apply to the so-called data controller. A data controller is the entity that decides for which purposes personal data will be processed, and how the processing will be executed. The data controller can use a so-called data processor. A data processor is an entity that is only allowed to process personal data as instructed by the data controller, and may not use the personal data for its own purposes.
We are the data controller when we process your personal data as described in this Privacy policy.

# Frontend Engineer
## Location
London
## Employment Type
Full time
## Location Type
Hybrid
## Department
TechEngineering
## Compensation
* L3 - Frontend EngineerL3 - Frontend Engineer £90K – £135K • £20K – £50K Equity
* L4 - Frontend EngineerL4 - Frontend Engineer £120K – £160K • £20K – £40K Equity
Our compensation is based on your levelling during the interview process, which we'll assess throughout the interview process
OverviewApplication
## **Our Mission**
At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: **procurement** – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger **50+ emails**, and pull in **Finance, Legal, Security, and IT** just to get something approved.
We’ve raised **$75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners,** and **Accel** to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.
The opportunity is massive. **Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it**. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the **4th fastest growing startup** in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.
**Our team previously scaled Tessian** (**cybersecurity tech,** backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel**,** acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like **Ben**, **Abs**, **Sabrina**, and **Rebe**.
## **Find out more about the team and life at Omnea** **here****.**
## **What We're Looking For**
We're looking for a **Frontend Engineer** to own the front end at Omnea.
Our design system is growing fast, our front-end architecture is becoming more complex, and right now ownership of these things is distributed. You'd be the person who takes this to the next level.
You'll work across every product team. You'll own the design system, own the front-end architecture, and set the standard for how we build interfaces. We're a tight-knit group of ambitious builders who hold the bar high. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple. The front end has to scale with it.
This is a craft role with real leverage. Almost every engineer at Omnea ships front end. What you build determines how well they do it.
Procurement is a harder interface problem than it sounds. Approval workflows that branch and re-route, dense tables people live in all day, intake forms that adapt to what someone is buying. Getting this right is the difference between software people tolerate and software people actually like using.
## **What Can You Expect On Our Engineering Team?**
* **Join a Skilled Team.** Become part of one of Europe's fastest-growing software companies, working alongside experienced full-stack product engineers and product designers from top technology businesses and startups.
* **Own the Design System.** You'll own our design system outright: components, patterns, tokens, documentation, and adoption. You'll partner closely with Design to turn intent into reusable, high-quality primitives.
* **Own the Front-End Architecture.** Deployment strategy, performance, build tooling, and the conventions everyone else follows. You'll set the direction rather than inherit it, working alongside the engineers and designers closest to each surface rather than owning it in isolation.
* **Leverage Across Every Team.** You'll work with all of our engineering teams on their most front-end-heavy projects. The work you do multiplies across the whole org.
* **A Real Design Partnership.** Every cross-functional team at Omnea has a dedicated Product Manager and Product Designer. You'll be the connective tissue between design intent and what actually ships, and the person designers come to when they want to know what's possible.
* **Work with Modern Technology.** TypeScript everywhere, React and Next.js on the front end, and Meticulous for automated visual regression testing, so you can refactor the design system without fear. Behind it sits Postgres and AWS serverless infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, and EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions, with Datadog for observability.
* **AI-Native Development.** AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude Code and agentic workflows every day to write, review, and ship code faster, and our product is itself built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows.
* **Continuous Delivery.** We deploy small, incremental changes to production multiple times per day, enabling rapid iteration and fast customer feedback loops.
* **Collaboration and Autonomy.** We operate as a high-trust team where individuals are expected to take ownership while collaborating closely to solve difficult problems.
* **Customers at the Center.** We regularly engage directly with customers to understand their problems, gather feedback, and ensure we're building products that create genuine value.
## **About You**
* **You're deep in React.** You've built complex, production React applications and you understand the framework properly, not just the API surface. Rendering behaviour, state, performance, and where things break at scale.
* **You've owned front-end infrastructure.** Rendering strategies, build tooling, bundle performance, and the architectural decisions underneath a large application.
* **You've built or owned a design system.** Not just consumed one. You've made the calls on component APIs, driven adoption across teams, and dealt with the messy reality of migration and versioning.
* **You have taste.** You care how things look and feel, you notice when something is only 90% right, and you can hold a genuine conversation with designers rather than just implementing tickets.
* **You know CSS deeply.** Layout, styling architecture, and building interfaces that hold up across breakpoints, themes, and edge cases. You treat accessibility and motion as part of the craft rather than a checklist at the end.
* **You're a strong engineer first.** Your depth and your interest sit in the front end, and that's the point of this role. But you're fluent in TypeScript generally and comfortable working beyond the browser when a problem calls for it.
* **You're motivated by impact.** You care about what your work actually achieves, not just how it's built. You thrive with the autonomy to make meaningful decisions and take real ownership of outcomes.
* **You're a team builder.** You're excited by maximising team performance, whether that means learning from others or taking the time to explain, give feedback, and level up those around you.
* **You're comfortable with ambiguity.** This role is new. Its shape will be partly yours to define, and you're happy tackling problems without a predefined solution, backed by an experienced team.

## **About Us**
**Phyllo** is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e.g. YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, and more). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators’ data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators’ data in a simple yet impactful way.
**Clayface** is our AI analyst for consumer brands, built on top of that data foundation. Insights and brand teams at consumer goods companies spend days pulling numbers together from retail, social, and syndicated sources before they can start analysing anything. Clayface does that work for them. You ask it a business question and it comes back with an answer: what changed, what is likely driving it, and what to look at next, with the source behind every number.
More info at:
* Clayface: https://www.clayface.ai/
* Phyllo: https://www.getphyllo.com/
* Our Crunchbase profile: https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/phyllo
## **About The Role**
We are looking for a **Product Manager to lead Clayface.** You will own what the analyst can do, how it arrives at an answer, and how much a brand team can trust what comes back. That means understanding the questions insights and category teams actually ask, designing the steps the product takes to answer them, and making sure those answers hold up when someone senior pushes back in a meeting.
This is a hands-on role. You will be close to the product every day: trying things yourself, reading what it produced, and deciding what to change. It is not an AI strategy role, and it is not a role where you write a brief and wait for engineering to come back with something.
## **What you’ll own**
### **Consumer brand insights**
* The roadmap for Clayface: which business questions we answer well next, which types of analysis we take on, and what we deliberately leave out.
* Spending real time with insights, brand, and category teams at consumer goods companies. You need to understand how decisions actually get made, what gets asked in the room, and where teams currently get stuck.
* Turning that understanding into a product that gives useful answers rather than impressive-looking output. An analysis that is technically correct but does not help someone decide anything is a failure.
* Writing clear requirements an engineer can build from without needing a second meeting.
### **An orchestrated platform for real-world use cases**
* Clayface is not a single prompt. It is a sequence of steps: find the right data, match it across sources, run the analysis, check the result, and explain it clearly. You will design how those steps fit together, which ones the system decides for itself, and where a person should stay in the loop.
* Making the product work across the messy range of questions real customers ask, not just the handful that demo well. That includes deciding what should happen when the data is thin, when two sources disagree, or when the honest answer is that we cannot tell yet.
* Working with engineering on what the platform needs so we can add new data sources, categories, and customers without rebuilding it each time.
* Balancing quality against speed and cost. How long an answer takes and what it costs us to produce are product decisions, not just engineering ones.
### **Quality and Trust**
* Deciding what a good answer looks like for each kind of question, and making sure we measure it rather than assume it. You will set the bar and work with engineering on how it gets checked. The specific methods will change as the product grows, and we expect you to have opinions on that.
* Making sure every number can be traced back to a source and a time period. Customers make expensive decisions on this output, and a confident wrong answer costs us far more than no answer.
* Testing properly before things go live. AI products fail quietly rather than loudly, so a few good examples is never enough evidence to ship.
* Owning the questions enterprise buyers ask about data handling, security, and how their data is used.
### **Working with the team**
* Partnering closely with engineering, design, data, sales, and customer success, and making sure the people who sell and support Clayface understand what it does well and where it is still weak.
* Connecting the product to outcomes that matter to the business: customers who keep using it, accounts that grow, and deals that close faster.
* Being the voice of the product internally and with customers, and bringing what you hear back into the roadmap.
## **You’ll be a good fit if**
## **Required**
* **5 years in product managemen**t, including at least one AI product or feature that real users used and that you measured after launch.
* You are **hands-on with AI products**. You have written and improved prompts yourself, looked closely at what the system produced, and worked out why it went wrong.
* A **working understanding** of how AI products are put together today: how a model gets the context it needs, how it uses tools and data sources, how multi-step workflows are strung together, and where these systems usually break.
* **Real experience with evaluating AI output**. You have set up ways to test quality systematically and used the results to decide what to change.
* You care about **evidence**. You check whether an answer is genuinely supported by the data, and you say so when it is not.
* Comfortable with **data**. You can write **SQL** or work in a **BI tool**, and you are appropriately suspicious of numbers that look too clean.
* Enough **technical depth** to have a real **conversation with engineers** about trade-offs, cost, speed, and data dependencies without needing everything explained from first principles. You do not need to write production code.
* **Clear writing**. A good spec from you should prompt specific questions about edge cases rather than confusion about what you meant.
* **Comfortable saying no**, including to people who are excited about something that demos well.
## **Preferred**
* A background as an engineer, analyst, or data scientist
* Experience with consumer goods, retail, or market research data: syndicated data, retailer sell-through, digital shelf, or social listening.
* Experience building products that sit on top of messy data from many different sources.
* Familiarity with tools for testing and monitoring AI products.
* Experience with B2B or enterprise customers, including what their security and procurement teams ask for.
* An advanced degree in a technical or business field.
## **What we offer**
* **Work from home:** work from home or your preferred location.
* **Flexible hours:** choose to work in the hours you feel most productive.
* **Innovate and evolve:** we’re building a high-growth, high-autonomy culture. We rely less on job titles and more on cultivating an environment where anyone can contribute, the best ideas win, and personal growth is driven by expanding impact rather than by title.
* **Real ownership:** Clayface is early. You will shape what it becomes rather than inherit someone else’s roadmap.
## **What’s in it for you?**
We invest in our people and believe in hiring high-potential, humble individuals who can rapidly grow their responsibilities as the company scales. You will infuse insights and ideas into business decision-making, solutions strategy, and the innovation roadmap for each product.
Most AI product roles are about adding a feature to something that already exists. This one is different. Clayface is trying to do the job of an analyst, on real data, for customers who will tell you straight away when the answer is wrong. If that is the kind of problem you want to work on, we would like to hear from you.
If you have worked on an AI product before, tell us about something it kept getting wrong and what you did about it. That will tell us more than a cover letter.

Portfolio Managers are investment decision-makers. They devise and implement investment strategies and processes to meet client goals and constraints, construct and manage portfolios, make decisions on what and when to buy and sell investments.
## How to become a Portfolio Manager
Portfolio management is a core topic in the, so it's not surprising that "Portfolio Manager" is one of the most common roles for CFA(R) charterholders. Although Portfolio Manager is typically not an entry-level position, some Portfolio Manager roles begin at the associate level (with only a few years of relevant experience required) and contribute analysis and research to the investment decision-making process. At the mid-senior level, portfolio management roles often involve directing a team of investment professionals or a larger portfolio of assets. In addition, many private wealth management firms employ Portfolio Managers who work directly with individual clients or provide support for client-facing advisors. The Portfolio Manager track can lead to management positions with broader responsibilities, such as a Managing Director or Head of Portfolio Management. Senior Portfolio Managers often report directly to a Chief Investment Officer (CIO), which makes portfolio management a potential to an executive position in an organization, whether as a CIO or a similar executive function with higher-level responsibility for the investment process.
Practitioners typically go into investment-decision making roles after several years working as an analyst. If you like generating investment ideas, developing and implementing investment strategy, can manage risk, and can remain resilient and decisive when faced with potential underperformance and poorly performing financial markets, this role could be right for you.
### Key skills for Portfolio Managers
Succeeding as a Portfolio Manager and in investment decision-making roles requires key skills in three areas:
Investment strategy and process.
Portfolio construction and execution.
Performance measurement and risk management.
### Qualifications
Typically, a Portfolio Manager holds a Bachelor's degree in finance or a related field. To showcase proficiency in a relevant interdisciplinary field, coursework should demonstrate a mastery of information, a love of reading, conceptual thinking, and idea generation. Employers also frequently give priority to candidates with the CFA designation as they have demonstrated a mastery of investment management.
### Typical Portfolio Manager salary
According to a \*2019 CFA Institute compensation study of charterholders and members, portfolio managers reported a typical, global total compensation of US$177,000 (US$126,000 base salary).
\*
## Other possible career tracks in investment decision-making
Throughout the, regardless of the industry sector or the type of firm, investment decision-makers are the ones who determine what funds and assets to buy and sell and when. Their approach to building portfolios and resource allocation will usually depend on their firm, their clients, and the financial goals the portfolio is trying to achieve. Managers typically start their careers in financial analyst roles. Other types of decision-making roles include:
* Hedge fund management
* Senior Manager
* Trader

The prediction pipelines are under strict SLAs; every prediction must be returned in under 300ms. When models are not performing as expected, it’s down to the Detection team to investigate why.
The Detection team is core to Ravelin’s success. They work in a deeply collaborative partnership with the Data Engineering team to design the data architecture and infrastructure that powers our ML systems.

# ******Engineering and Project Delivery******
## Company Overview
React are looking for people who understand how engineering work becomes safe, coordinated delivery on site. These roles will sit at the interface between engineering, planning, commercial management, contractors, clients and the site organisation – maintaining clarity, resolving blockers and making sure commitments translate into progress.
### Role purpose
Own defined projects or work packages and connect engineering intent with safe, practical site delivery.
### Experience Guide
Relevant project and site-delivery experience; capability and context are more important than a fixed number of years.
### Working Location
Office based in West Cumbria. Regular client-site attendance is an essential part of the role, but this is not necessarily a permanently site-based post.
## What you will do
* Take ownership of a defined project, work package or delivery scope from mobilisation through completion.
* Turn requirements and engineering outputs into clear scopes, plans, deliverables, interfaces and actions.
* Coordinate engineering, site, safety, planning, commercial, supply-chain and client stakeholders.
* Maintain a credible view of progress, risks, assumptions, decisions, changes, dependencies and resource needs.
* Chair or support delivery meetings and ensure actions lead to decisions and progress.
* Use site knowledge to test whether plans, designs and sequences are practical and safely deliverable.
* Support procurement, supplier engagement, contractor management and technical/commercial clarification as required.
* Prepare concise reports and recommendations that give clients and React decision confidence.
* Identify blockers early, develop recovery options and escalate proportionately.
* Capture lessons and improve the way React integrates engineering and project delivery.
## **What success should look like**
* The project or package has one clear owner, an agreed scope, visible priorities and a realistic delivery plan.
* Engineering, commercial, schedule and site considerations are integrated rather than managed separately.
* Risks and blockers are surfaced early with clear actions, decisions and escalation routes.
* Clients receive reliable information and have confidence that commitments will be followed through.
* Site work is prepared with enough technical and organisational clarity to reduce avoidable delay and rework.
## **What we are looking for**
### Essential experience & evidence
* Relevant experience delivering engineering, construction, installation, commissioning, maintenance, modification or decommissioning work in a site environment.
* Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and maintain control of scope, actions, risks and decisions.
* Practical understanding of safety, permits, access, sequencing, interfaces and the realities of working on an operational or regulated site.
* Clear communication and confidence dealing with clients, engineers, supervisors, suppliers and contractors.
* Evidence of ownership, reliability and constructive challenge when a plan is not credible.
* Ability and willingness to travel to and work at client sites as required.
### ****Desirable, but not essential****
* Nuclear, decommissioning, defence, energy, process plant or major-infrastructure site experience.
* Engineering degree or technical qualification for the Project Engineer route; recognised project-management qualification for the Project Manager route.

* Experience managing fixed-price, target-cost or multidisciplinary consultancy work packages.
* Current or previous security clearance / site access where relevant.
## ****The behaviours that matter in this role****
* You enjoy understanding why a problem exists, not just producing the requested document.
* You know when more analysis is needed and when the team has enough evidence to move forward.
* You are willing to question inherited assumptions and propose a simpler, more effective solution.
* You take pride in technically credible work that can be used by clients and delivery teams.
* You share knowledge, accept review constructively and support others without needing formal authority.
## ****What you can expect from React****
* Visible ownership of projects and work packages with direct client contact.
* A role that values both engineering credibility and delivery discipline.
* Support from experienced technical, project and commercial colleagues without excessive hierarchy.
* Opportunities to grow into larger project, programme or project-engineering leadership roles.
* A team that expects practical judgement and gives people room to make a difference.

All short-listed candidates will be required to prove that they have the Right to Work in the UK during the recruitment process.

Iron Mountain is seeking a commercially and operationally driven Grid Interconnection & Power Delivery Lead Europe to join our Global Data Centers team. In this role, your primary mandate is to secure access to power for our expanding data center portfolio. As the commercial and process orchestrator for our grid connections, you will focus on negotiating grid access agreements with TSOs and DSOs, translating utility contracts into clear business impacts, and driving the end-to-end timeline to ensure internal teams and project managers execute perfectly.
#### What You'll Do (Responsibilities)
* **Determine the Pathway to Power:** Know the system connection process for target markets, the responsible parties and the technical criteria for meeting new site needs. This includes a general understanding of system upgrade processes, power redundancy practices, system voltages and components necessary to delivery power.
* **Commercial Negotiation & Translation:** Lead the negotiation of grid connection agreements (ESAs) with European TSOs and DSOs. You will translate these complex utility contracts and grid constraints into clear operational and commercial realities for IMDC projects and our end customers. This includes validating the technical aspects of power design and delivery to the site, including upstream system resources.
* **Process Orchestration:** Own the master timeline for power delivery. You will dictate "who does what and when," ensuring that local Project Managers for new and existing data center locations hit critical verification, submission, and operational milestones at exactly the right moment.
* **Contract Lifecycle Management:** Deeply understand the ongoing requirements of our grid access contracts. You will manage the lifetime of the contract, ensuring we meet utilization thresholds, mitigate commercial risk, and maintain compliance long after the initial agreement is signed.
* **Cross-Functional & 3rd Party Leadership:** Act as the central node between our external technical consultants, utilities, sales teams, and construction teams. You will ensure technical data is seamlessly handed off and applied to the commercial strategy.
* **Risk & Timeline Alignment:** Actively monitor utility requirements against reality. You will track critical thresholds (such as underutilization clauses or customer ramp-up timelines) to ensure our capacity commitments align with actual customer deployment.
#### What You'll Bring (Skills & Qualifications)
* **Technical Understanding:** Knowledge of electrical system components and voltages sufficient to ensure contracts deliver power aligned to the needs of our new facilities.
* **Commercial & Operational Rigor:** You are a meticulous process manager and a strong commercial negotiator. You know how to hold cross-functional teams and external utilities accountable to strict timelines.
* **Cross-Functional Teamwork:** You are highly comfortable and effective at working across different teams. You build solid relationships naturally and can bridge the communication gaps between technical engineers, commercial sales teams, and external utility partners.
* **Industry & Utility Expertise:** Demonstrable experience in energy procurement, utility relations, or infrastructure project management for energy-intensive consumers. You must have a track record of negotiating directly with European TSOs and DSOs.
* **Contractual Fluency:** You must be able to read a complex grid connection contract and immediately understand what it means for the project's construction timeline and the customer's ramp-up schedule.
* **Location:** Must be based in the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, or Spain.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in business, electrical engineering, project management, or an energy-related discipline.
* **Pan-European Presence:** Willingness and ability to travel as needed to active project sites and utility offices across Europe to ensure critical infrastructure milestones are met and local relationships are maintained.

* Flexible work options to support work-life balance.

* Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.

**The Opportunity**
Reliance Foundry is looking for an experienced engineering leader to take ownership of our engineering and product development function. This is a role for someone who enjoys leading people and solving real physical-product problems - moving ideas from concept through design, simulation, prototyping, testing, certification, and commercial launch.
You will lead an established engineering department, work closely with our Senior Leadership Team, and help shape how we develop the next generation of safety, security, and infrastructure products. Our products combine mechanical and structural engineering with civil, electrical, and electronic elements, so success requires strong technical judgment and the ability to bring specialists together - not expertise in every discipline.
We are more interested in someone who has successfully led an engineering function and brought complex engineered products to market.
**About Reliance Foundry**
Reliance Foundry has been improving public and commercial spaces since 1925. We design and supply bollards - protective posts used for safety, security, and traffic control - along with outdoor furnishings and custom metal components. Our expanding product portfolio is driving growth across North America's security and infrastructure markets.
**What You'll Own**
**Engineering Leadership**
- Lead the engineering department, setting priorities, standards, accountabilities, and resource plans while developing the people on the team.
- Create an environment of strong technical debate, disciplined decision-making, continuous learning, and clear ownership.
- Contribute as a member of the leadership team and work cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, and HR.
**Product Development & Execution**
- Move complex engineered products from concept through commercialization using disciplined project and program management.
- Translate customer and market needs into clear technical requirements, development plans, design reviews, validation plans, and launch readiness.
- Ensure designs consider manufacturability, assembly, installation, serviceability, cost, quality, and supply-chain realities from the outset.
- Build stronger, more repeatable product-development systems while preserving the speed and practicality of a growing company.
**Technical Direction**
- Provide strong mechanical and structural engineering judgment across product design, materials, loading, stress, and failure modes.
- Guide FEA and simulation work: understand modelling assumptions, challenge inputs and results, identify risk, and determine when specialist analysis is required. You do not need to be the company's primary simulation SME.
- Coordinate internal and external specialists across civil, electrical, electronics, testing, and other disciplines, ensuring the complete system works together.
- Oversee prototyping, physical testing, certification, and compliance with applicable standards such as ASTM, CSA, and UL.
**What We're Looking For**
- Engineering degree in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
- Approximately 8+ years of progressive experience in mechanical, structural, industrial, or complex physical-product engineering.
- Previous responsibility for leading an engineering department or engineering function, including people leadership, priorities, performance, and delivery.
- A strong track record taking complex engineered products from concept through commercialization - not simply completing isolated design projects.
- Solid understanding of FEA and simulation and the technical judgment to review and direct this work, even if you are not the hands-on specialist.
- Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple engineering disciplines and integrate specialist work into a successful overall product or system.
- Strong practical judgment: you can balance technical rigor, commercial realities, speed, cost, manufacturability, and risk.
- Clear communication skills and the confidence to challenge assumptions, make decisions, and explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.
**Experience That Would Be an Asset**
- SolidWorks and/or Abaqus experience, particularly involving structural, dynamic, impact, or nonlinear analysis.
- Experience with safety, security, automotive, heavy equipment, industrial infrastructure, fabricated metal products, or other performance-critical physical products.
- Experience with product testing and certification standards such as ASTM, CSA, or UL.
- Design for Manufacturability (DFM), supplier collaboration, and outsourced manufacturing.
- P.Eng. designation or eligibility, and/or experience with SR&ED, IRAP, or other technical R&D programs.
**Work Environment & Compensation**
- Location: Surrey, BC. This is primarily an on-site role. During probation, the expectation is five days per week in the office because the work involves physical products, prototyping, testing, and close team collaboration. Some reasonable work-from-home flexibility is available after probation when the work allows.
- Benefits include extended health and dental coverage, vision care, life insurance, employee assistance program, paid time off, RRSP matching, on-site parking, and company events.
**Why This Role**
This is an opportunity to run an engineering function where your decisions are visible and consequential. You will have meaningful ownership of people, process, technical direction, and new-product development in a company that is large enough to tackle serious engineering challenges and small enough for a strong leader to materially change how the work gets done.
To apply for this opportunity, please submit your resume and a brief letter outlining your relevant experience and qualifications to: recruitment@reliance-foundry.com

# **Sr Software Engineer, Ads Auctions & Marketplace Optimization**
#### Advertising | Cambridge, United Kingdom | ID: 11276

## Teamwork makes the stream work.
### **Roku is changing how the world watches TV**
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
### **What does the team work on?**
Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the US, Canada and Mexico, with more than 100 million active accounts. Every ad impression across that platform has to be cleared and priced in real time — that is what the Ads Auctions and Marketplace Optimization team does. We build the auction mechanics, the pricing and pacing logic, and the low-latency systems that run them, balancing outcomes for advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku on every request. We are growing the team in Cambridge, which is becoming its largest hub, alongside colleagues in Amsterdam, Austin, San Jose, Ukraine and Uruguay — so you would be shaping how the UK side of this team works rather than inheriting it.
### **What is the role?**
You will build the systems that apply mathematical and algorithmic rigour to optimise across multiple objectives, deciding which ads get served, in which placements, and when. The work spans auction mechanics, optimisation, the output of predictive ML models, and the real-time infrastructure underneath, mostly in Java on the JVM. It is hands-on and senior in scope: expect to move between whiteboard-level design and production code in the same week, and to own problems from framing through rollout. You will work directly with the hiring manager and a small group of senior engineers, in codebases shared with other ads engineers, on problems where your decisions are visible in revenue. You will optimise for second-order effects in a marketplace where participants react to each other, and to us, in real time. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about solving these kinds of problems.
### **How will I use AI at Roku?**
At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.
We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.
