# # About Salesforce
Salesforce brings customer data, CRM, analytics, and AI together on a trusted platform. Our teams help organizations turn complex business and data requirements into secure, scalable solutions. In this role, you will help customers put Data 360 into production and build the technical foundation for reliable, enterprise-grade use cases.
# # About the Role
Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.
Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.
You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.
This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it.
# # What You'll Do
* Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
* Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
* Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
* Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
* Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
* Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
* Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
* Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
* Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
* Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
* Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.
* Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
* Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.

* You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
* You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
* You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
* You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
* You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
* You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
* You've built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
* You've implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
* You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
* You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
* You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
* You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.
* You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
* You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform.

You'll be Jigsaw's embedded data privacy advisor: the person product, engineering, and customer-facing teams turn to when a data or privacy question needs a real answer. This is a fractional role (starting at roughly 2 days a week in-office), working closely alongside our Legal Ops Associate.
The focus for this role will be translating legal and technical complexity into commercially-focused, actionable responses to help free up teams to move quickly. In practice, this could be advising the product team on what compliance actions we need to take ahead of a new product release, making case-by-case decisions for customers with unique compliance requirements, or conducting analysis on customer DPAs ahead of a change to data processing locations, right through to how to answer a client's questions about our AI features.

Turn specific customer contract terms into practical, commercial recommendations, weighing real risk instead of defaulting to "no"

Join customer calls to speak credibly with clients' own data privacy counsel, many of whom are lawyers or privacy specialists themselves
Translate complex legal and technical concepts clearly for non-legal, technical teams internally
Help build a genuine "privacy by design" culture at Jigsaw - getting privacy thinking embedded at the start of projects, not bolted on at the end
Spot opportunities to improve our templates, playbooks, and processes proactively, alongside the day-to-day reactive work

A working understanding of UK & US privacy laws, including UK & EU GDPR, the UK Data Protection Act and CCPA, ideally with experience applying them in a live commercial context, not just in theory

To be genuinely comfortable with cross-border and international data transfer questions

Excellent communication skills on two levels: credible and precise with legally sophisticated clients, and clear and accessible for non-legal internal teams
High ownership balanced with genuine collaboration, and able to build consensus
Comfort with a fractional working pattern - broadly protected days, with the pragmatic flexibility to handle something urgent (like a data incident) outside them

Familiarity with other privacy frameworks, including AI governance or AI-related compliance questions
CIPP/E or CIPM certification
Experience working with clients in heavily regulated industries (law firms, accountancies, financial services)
Prior experience at a similar-stage scale-up with a broad base of regulated, legally sophisticated customers

## Our Mission
We’re the software arm of a national business advisory and financial services group, building a multi-product SaaS platform serving B2B customers across the UK — you will be working on enterprise-grade Fintech products covering risk management, business intelligence and analytics, client relationship management, and people analytics, in addition to aiding in the creation of AI tooling and software for internal use to help drive the business forward.

Much of what we build originates as ideas from within the engineering team, alongside work driven by the wider business, and engineers are involved in design from the outset rather than simply working to tickets written by somebody else. We want people with bright ideas, who want to have an impact and make truly world class software products.
We’re an agent-native engineering team who work by directing frontier AI agents through an in-house delivery pipeline built on adversarial review and automated verification, then reviewing the results by hand rather than writing everything ourselves from scratch. This is not a “vibe coding” role, and we’ll want you to actively develop your understanding of the code you are producing. We’ll provide the support to help you on that journey.

* Take ownership of whole production features end-to-end and deliver them across the stack.
* Learn to direct software rather than type out code: decompose problems, write precise specifications, review AI-written code in depth, and design the verification that proves it works.
* Work with an AI tooling budget most firms reserve for their most senior engineers.

TypeScript end-to-end · Next.js + React 19 · NestJS microservices · PostgreSQL · Docker · Azure · frontier AI coding agents

* Organised, efficient and a genuine interest and willingness to make a positive contribution
* Flexible and proactive approach to work and the ability to work under pressure

Lymington Precision Engineers (LPE) is a Senior Flexonics Group company, and is a leading manufacturer of precision machined components, assemblies and kit sets for the Oil and Gas, Telecommunications, Aerospace and Defence, Land and Sea Systems, Nuclear and Marine industries and emerging markets.
We pride ourselves on our ability to manufacture extremely complicated components and assemblies utilising state of the art equipment and facilities.
We are an AS/EN 9100, ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certified company and offer a fully engineered solution, from design concept through to high volume manufacture, to supply a range of world class products to our customers.
We evaluate every part of our customers’ requirements which enables us to provide a truly bespoke high-quality solution that delivers real value.
## Job Description
**Manufacturing Engineer - What does the job involve?**
The Manufacturing Engineer will be responsible for developing, improving and supporting robust manufacturing processes within a high-precision engineering environment. The role will support the manufacture of complex, high-integrity components and assemblies for demanding customers in the nuclear submarine, defence, aerospace and wider safety-critical sectors.
The successful candidate will work closely with production, quality, inspection, planning, supply chain and customer-facing teams to ensure products are manufactured safely, efficiently, right first time and in accordance with customer, regulatory and quality requirements.
**Hours of work:** 39 hours per week.
**Dayshift** - Monday to Thursday 7.30am to 4.30pm with 30-minute unpaid break for lunch and Friday 8.00am to 1.00pm
**Manufacturing Engineer - What will my responsibilities include?’**
* Develop, implement and maintain manufacturing methods, routings, work instructions and process control documentation for precision-machined components and assemblies.
* Provide day-to-day technical support to the shop floor, resolving manufacturing issues, non-conformances, bottlenecks and process variation.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI), including review of drawings, specifications, tolerances, materials, tooling, fixtures, inspection requirements and manufacturability.
* Define and improve methods of manufacture to meet customer requirements for safety, quality, cost, delivery and compliance.
* Drive continuous improvement activities using appropriate tools such as root cause analysis, 8D, PFMEA, control plans, capability studies, 5S/6S, Kaizen and value stream mapping.
* Design, specify or support the introduction of jigs, fixtures, tooling, gauges and production aids to improve repeatability, safety and productivity.
* Work with CNC programmers, machinists and inspection personnel to optimise machining processes, cycle times, tool life, set-up methods and right-first-time performance.
* Support First Article Inspection, process validation and production readiness activities for new or changed products.

## Introduction to Shaype
Shaype is a global fintech headquartered in Sydney and with offices in London, Belfast, Glasgow and Toronto. * Be confident with operational data and systems: strong Excel, dashboards, a reconciliation platform, a ticketing system, and clear tickets for our Tech team.

## About the role
You'll keep Shaype's UK settlement, reconciliation and payments cycle running each day, picking up financial crime work alongside it. You'll sit with our Global CTO and senior Tech team in Glasgow, which gives you visibility most operations roles at this level don't get, and lets you close feedback loops that currently take a full day to cross time zones.
The rest of your time goes into building: redesigning processes as volumes grow, supporting testing and releases, and laying the operational foundations for our expansion into Canada. This is a hands-on, mid to senior role. Not the right fit if you want a finished operation handed to you. Right fit if you want to build one and own it.
Key Responsibilities include, but not limited to:
***Settlement and reconciliation***
* Run daily reconciliations: match statements and scheme files, investigate and resolve breaks.
* Verify card scheme settlement files land as expected, chasing the processor when they don't.
* Manage the multi-currency settlement cycle, checking funding and booking transfers under two-person approval.
* Produce daily, weekly and monthly reporting, keeping trackers audit ready.
***Payments and second-line client support***
* Second line for clients' own support teams on issues they can't resolve, including disputed transactions across card and Australian domestic rails.
* Manage payment disputes end to end and produce the weekly dispute report.
* Handle recalls, returns and traces with clearing partners, knowing where our responsibility ends and the client's begins.
***Financial crime operations***
* Work the alert queue and onboarding cases: identity checks, screening, PEP and sanctions.
* Run daily due diligence reviews, prepare suspicious matter reports and regulatory lodgements.
***Project and improvement work***
* Redesign processes for today's volume: map, simplify, control, document.
* Support UAT and give operational sign-off on platform and tooling changes.
* Work through incidents, file re-runs and continuity exercises alongside Tech.
* Cover other parts of the operation through leave and absence, and manage suppliers and clearing partners.
* Take on ad hoc projects: new clients, new payment types, platform migrations. Over time, become the person both the UK and Australian teams come to for how a process actually works.
## What experience you will have
***Essential***
* Typically expect 5+ years hands-on ownership of a daily reconciliation or settlement cycle in a regulated payments environment. We care what you can demonstrate, not the number.

* Visa scheme settlement, multi-currency, FX, nostro accounts or treasury float experience.

* As we grow into Canada, this role may take on a part in supporting it, we'll shape that together as we get there.

***Customer-Centric Mindset***
Client and customer experience shapes how you work. You hold the boundary between what's ours and what's the client's, and you handle disputes and support issues with the same care whether the amount is large or small.
***Ownership and Follow-Through***
You take a process from start to finish, chase down what doesn't balance, and fix root causes rather than working around them.
***Operational Excellence and Execution Focus***
Daily cut-offs matter here, and you understand why. You bring discipline to reconciliation, settlement and reporting, and look for ways to make each process more scalable as volumes grow.
***Risk Management and Regulatory Awareness***
You work comfortably under AML/CTF obligations and know when to solve a problem yourself and when to escalate immediately. Control and accuracy matter as much as speed.
***Technology and Data Fluency***
You're comfortable with data and systems, and can write a clear ticket for the Tech team. If you've automated something before, even in a spreadsheet, that curiosity matters to us.

## Job description
Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone in our operations. Now, we're on the lookout for a Product Manager to own the operational and quality-release layers of our pharma cold-chain platform - the capabilities that shift the supply chain from reactive firefighting to proactive prevention, and turn every shipment into audit-ready, released product. You bring strong technical expertise, a strategic mindset, and the ability to drive innovative product development in AI-driven supply chain solutions.
📍 **Location:** We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with **remote working available within these countries**. For those based in Switzerland, we operate a **hybrid working model** due to our local office presence.
Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.
Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.
Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.
**Why SkyCell?**
🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.
🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.
🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.
💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.
🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.
**What You'll Do:**
* Own the strategy and roadmap for real-time cold-chain operations and product release
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, sales, and marketing, to bring products to market successfully
* Conduct market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive threats in the industry
* Define and prioritise product features and requirements based on customer feedback and business objectives
* Manage the product lifecycle from concept to launch
* Align with other product managers to create joint offerings for SkyCell customers
* Ensure compliance with industry regulations and standards throughout the product development process
* Work closely with key collaborators to leverage their expertise and insights in the pharma sector
* Analyse product performance metrics and make data-driven decisions to enhance user satisfaction and business outcomes
* Engage with customers and stakeholders to gather feedback and foster strong relationships
## Job requirements
**What You'll Bring:**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Pharma, or a related field
* Proven experience in product management, within the pharmaceutical industry or supply chain
* Familiarity with the latest trends and technologies in product development and supply chain management, ideally including real-time monitoring, alerting, control-tower / operational response, or quality release and root-cause analysis solutions
* Possessing knowledge of IoT solutions provides a plus
**What's In It For You?**
⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life.
🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.
🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. **Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above.**
🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program.
👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave.
🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind.

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

# SLR is a global leader in sustainability solutions, working with clients to help make sustainability happen, within a collaborative, people-first culture.
Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced **Associate or Principal Hydrologist** to join our established Flood Risk and Water Environment team, delivering high-profile projects across the UK for public and private sector clients.
You'll join a friendly, collaborative group of Hydrologists, Hydraulic Modellers, Hydrogeologists, Water Resources Planners and Water Quality Scientists.
Whilst we would be keen to hire into an office with an existing hydrology team presence, including Manchester, London, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Newcastle or Nottingham, we would be happy to consider other office locations or remote working for the right person.
You'll work across a diverse portfolio of projects for both public and private sector clients, including developers, Local Flood Authorities, water companies and environmental regulators. As a senior member of the team, you'll combine technical excellence with project leadership, helping to shape and grow our hydrology capability.
The role includes:
* Leading the delivery, review and quality assurance of hydrological assessments for flood risk and water environment projects
* Mentoring and supporting the development of junior colleagues
* Developing and improving technical approaches, tools and methodologies
* Preparing fee proposals and contributing to project planning and resource management

* Ensure internal infrastructure and systems comply with organisational security policies, standards, and applicable regulatory requirements
* Report on the status of internal security controls, vulnerabilities, and incidents to the CISO, escalating material risks as required
* Support external audits (e.g. ISO 27001, client audits) where internal infrastructure is in scope

* Proven experience leading or managing a technical team, including workload allocation, mentoring, and performance development

* Working knowledge of recognised security frameworks and standards (e.g. ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus)

Internally we call our services Practices, which is where this role title comes from.
The Practice Lead owns and develops that service. You will make sure what we offer clients remains relevant three years from now, and that our engineers can deliver it. The work falls into four parts:
* Articulate our service. Support the go-to-market teams selling Future Systems Engineering into our sectors: energy and utilities, financial services, government, insurance.

* Enable new kinds of work. Develop the approaches, offerings and commercial propositions that let us take on engagements we have not run before.
* Strengthen our capability. Run the systems engineering Community of Practice, spread good ideas between accounts, and raise the technical bar across the company.

The client work sits mostly at the front of engagements: early conversations, discovery, architecture reviews, workshops and diagnostics, then enabling and supporting the delivery teams who run the resulting programmes.
Practice Leads work as a team, one per service, and report to the CTO. They sit in an office of the CTO alongside our two heads of capability and Vendor Relations. # Reward Manager – Compensation, Benefits & People Analytics
**Imagine shaping how we reward, recognise and invest in our people.......** As **Reward Manager – Compensation, Benefits & People Analytics**, you'll play a pivotal role in helping Splendid Hospitality Group make informed, data-driven people decisions that support our continued growth.
Reporting to the **Group People Director**, you'll combine reward expertise with strong analytical capability to develop and deliver our compensation and benefits strategy while providing the insight that enables better workforce planning, investment decisions and organisational performance.
Working across our hotels, restaurants, care homes and Head Office functions, you'll transform complex people data into meaningful insight, helping leaders make confident decisions around pay, benefits, workforce planning and organisational design.
You'll also play a key role in our People systems transformation, supporting the mobilisation of our HRIS and ensuring our people data is accurate, well governed and capable of delivering high-quality reporting and analytics for the future.
If you're passionate about reward, data and improving the colleague experience, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact across a diverse and growing business. **This is a hybrid role based at our Head Office in Watford, with an expectation of 3 - 4 days per week on-site.**
## What You Will Do In This Splendid Role
Reward plays a vital role in helping us attract, retain and recognise great people. In this role, you'll combine reward expertise with data-driven insight to help shape informed people decisions across the business. Here's what you'll be doing:
* Partner with the Group People Director and Group Head of People to develop and deliver our compensation and benefits strategy.
* Lead annual reward activity, including salary reviews, bonus cycles and benefits administration.
* Produce meaningful people analytics, dashboards and reporting to support reward, workforce planning and business decisions.
* Build financial models and scenario analysis to support organisational design, workforce planning and people investment.
* Champion the accuracy, governance and integrity of people and reward data across our systems.
* Play a key role in our HRIS implementation and ongoing optimisation, supporting data, reporting and system improvements.
* Work closely with Finance and senior stakeholders to provide commercially focused reward insight and recommendations.
* Continuously improve reporting, processes and automation to create a more efficient, insight-driven People function.
## What Makes You Splendid
We're looking for someone who combines reward expertise with commercial thinking and a passion for using data to drive better people decisions.
You'll also bring:
* Experience in **Compensation & Benefits, Reward, People Analytics** or a similar specialist role.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data, build financial models and turn insight into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Experience delivering reward activities such as salary reviews, benchmarking, reporting and workforce planning.
* Confidence using HR systems (HRIS), Excel and people data to produce accurate reporting and meaningful analytics.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build trusted relationships across all levels of the business.
* A proactive, commercially minded approach, always looking for opportunities to improve processes, reporting and the colleague experience.
**We live by our values, and we'd love you to bring them to life every day:**
* **Nimble** – You adapt quickly to changing priorities, embrace new ways of working and use insight to support agile business decisions.
* **Honest** – You build trust through accurate data, fair reward practices and transparent, evidence-based recommendations.
* **Brilliant** – You take pride in delivering high-quality analysis, meaningful insight and continuously improving the way we work.
* **Open** – You collaborate across teams, share knowledge and build strong relationships that lead to better, more informed decisions.
## Our Splendid Benefits:
When you join Splendid, you will enjoy a reward package to support your lifestyle, wellbeing and career. Here are just some of the benefits on offer:
* Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - confidential wellbeing support whenever you need it with 24/7 access to remote GP appointments.
* Hotel Room Discounts - stay with us or our partner hotels at special team rates including discounted rates for friends and family.
* Food & Beverage Discounts - enjoy meals and drinks at reduced prices across our hotels.
* Life Assurance - peace of mind for you and your loved ones.
* Salary Sacrifice - Car Scheme: our team members can enjoy the ultimate benefit of driving a brand new, full insured and maintained car for a fixed monthly amount taken from their salary.
* Stream - access your earned wages up to 50% whenever you need them giving you financial flexibility and Highstreet discounts available.
* Pension - auto enrolment into the company pension scheme.
* Learning & Development - opportunities available to progress your skills and career.
## About Splendid Hospitality Group
We’re a rarity - a successful, independent, family-run business that not only puts our people and those we work with first, but also gives back to the lives and communities we impact. Our aim is to become the very best hospitality group in the UK by nurturing our dedicated team of market specialists, who help us make a positive difference to everyone we work with.

## Description
**Location:** This role offers a hybrid working setup based in either of the following locations:
**London, UK:** Hybrid (minimum 1 day per week in the office)
**Montpellier, France:** Hybrid (minimum 3 days per week in the office)
Regular collaboration between teams in France and the UK. In-person training required.

At Sportscape, home of SportPursuit and Private Sport Shop we leverage data to deliver the right content to the right audience, optimise our marketing spend for maximum impact, make informed product purchasing decisions, and quickly address supply chain challenges. We have ambitious plans to do even more and further empower our teams with data-driven decision-making. To support these efforts, we are seeking a Data and Insight Analyst to join our Central Data Team.
In this role, you'll play a crucial part in using data and insights to enhance our business operations, driving revenue growth and improving efficiency as we scale. You will have the unique opportunity to collaborate closely with every team across the business. By understanding their operations and challenges, you'll identify how data can help solve problems and unlock new opportunities.
**A little bit more about this role:**
This is a hybrid position, offering flexibility for remote work and the opportunity to collaborate in person at either of our offices in London or Vendargues (France), where our team regularly comes together.
This role suits someone in the early stage of their career. Some professional experience is welcome but we would highly value a passionate candidate with little to no professional experience.
We look for someone who is genuinely interested in what makes our business tick, and how data and analysis can be used to understand and improve every aspect of the business, generating long-term value. The role will be varied and engaging, but will include:

* Help inform business decisions with insightful reporting

* A chance to deploy cutting-edge machine learning techniques that really have an impact

* Have excellent analytical and numeracy skills
* Be skilled in SQL
* Be skilled in Python or R
* Possess a passion for data and accuracy
* Be very logical and very detailed
* Have a numerate degree
* Good written and verbal communication skills, comfortable explaining simple conclusions from complex analysis to anyone across the business
* Be curious and demonstrate a strong desire to constantly learn
* Be an effective communicator in both written and verbal English
**Nice to have but not essential:**

* Hands-on experience with LLMs, agentic patterns, and evaluation approaches, alongside an eagerness to keep pace with the rapidly evolving GenAI ecosystem.

* Ability to communicate in French is a plus

## Benefits

**About Sportscape**
Sportscape is Europe's leading member-only, off-price ecommerce platform dedicated to sports and outdoor enthusiasts. Formed in 2022 through the merger of two high-growth businesses, SportPursuit in the UK and Private Sport Shop in France, the group has rapidly scaled into a pan-European category leader. ## 今、大注目のインフラエンジニアって?
**もはやインフラエンジニアは裏方ではない!**
###### **今、大注目株のインフラエンジニア、その背景とは?**
十数年前、ゲーム業界と言えば、ゲームそのものが主体であり、環境を用意するインフラエンジニアは開発環境を提供できれば良く、ゲームがお客様の手に渡ったあとも特にインフラが関与する事はありませんでした。
しかし時は流れ、ゲームキャラのグラフィックデータが当たり前のようにGBクラスを超え、髪の毛の1本1本が描写されるレベルにまでグラフィッククオリティが益々進化していくコンソールゲーム、世界中のユーザーが、いつでも何処でも、あたかも隣に居るかのように共にプレイできるMMOオンラインゲームやスマートフォンゲームなど、ゲームの在り方は大きく進化を遂げています。
これらを実現するには開発の段階から膨大な量の処理を要求され、それは年々増加の一途をたどり、カバー範囲は世界中に広がっていきます。
今や当社では、数百名の開発者が一斉に百TB級のデータを編集/読み込みを行い、共に結合しあうことで「ファイナルファンタジー」のようなタイトルが生み出され、オンラインサービスが組み合わさる場合は、世界中から数十万という同時アクセスを受けつつも、お客様にフラストレーションを与えることなく快適にプレイできるインフラ環境を用意するのが必須となります。
こういったキーとなるインフラを最新の技術と高パフォーマンスの製品を駆使し設計/構築、ユーザーのニーズに応える形へ日々チューニングをかけていくのがインフラエンジニアです。
###### **あなたに合ったロールが待っている!**
当社の特徴的なインフラエンジニアのジョブを3つ紹介します。 通信量100Gbpsなんて当たり前!単なる動画/画像データのやり取りだけではないゲーム通信のトランザクションとトラフィック量を操り、そして世界中からの接続性をインターネットバックボーンを駆使して実現するネットワークエンジニア。
保有しているデータ量は総量PBクラス!数十万のお客様が同時にプレイできるゲーム空間の元を数万台ベースで実現、いまや提供範囲は世界を跨り活動するサーバーエンジニア。
Msの揺らぎを許さず、秒間数十万のクエリを捌ききる!ゲーム空間内のバトル/バザーなどにおいて数十~数百万のユーザが秒間同時に処理を求めても何のフラストレーションも与えず即応するデータベースを組み上げるデータベースエンジニア。
スクウェア・エニックスのインフラエンジニアは、それぞれの領域がIT業界内でもトップクラスの規模で実運用し、自身で考え生み出したインフラでプライドを持って動かしていきます。
###### **スクウェア・エニックスが常に技術の最先端を走るわけは?**
オンライン化されたタイトルも130タイトル以上にのぼり、各コンテンツも進化をつづけるなか、これらを提供していくには従来のやり方では通用しなくなってきています。
今や自社のデータセンターとパブリッククラウドをあわせ、ハイブリッドで運営しているサーバーは数万台を超え、ネットワーク領域ではインターネット事業者としての資格もあり自社でインターネットバックボーンを運営、CDNの活用は年間数十PB以上という大規模で高度なインフラを持ち合わせています。そのため、ゲーム内のデータベースへOracle Exadataを利用したり、社内LANへFabric Path導入など、いくつかメーカー事例もありますが、常に最先端の技術にアンテナを張り、インフラエンジニアが創意工夫でベストな構成を実現している自由度も当社の特徴の一つです。ほぼ大手どころ全てのメーカー製品を実導入し、Ansible、Puppet、Chefなど幅広く構成管理ツールを活用、プライベートクラウド環境の構築、SDN等への技術検証と、全体的な自動化/オーケストレーションに向けた取り組みなども行っています。先端技術/製品情報習得にも貪欲で、ITメッカのシリコンバレーに向かい様々なITベンチャーの情報収集を行なったりもしています。
###### **インフラは生き物のよう!使役できる力を獲得しよう!**
オンラインサービスゲームは日々ストーリー/アイテムなどコンテンツ/仕様が追加されていき、それによってサーバー間のデータ連携も変わり、ユーザ挙動によって予測を大きく逸れる事もあります。この変化に耐えうるべくインフラも常に進化させていかなければなりません。
その要求に早いレスポンスで応え、試行錯誤しながら、そのタイトルに一番適したインフラを提供していくのもインフラエンジニアの能力を発揮する場です。企画を聞いたときには一般的に検討すらされない事も多々あり、人によってはゾッとするかもしれません。でもエンジニア心をくすぐる要件が満載で、実現できる糸口を見つけ出し、普段は扱えないようなハイエンドの環境を駆使して実現した時の充実感も半端ありません。

###### ゲーム開発もIT技術もトップクラス
少し私の話をしますと前職は、通信サービスを担当するエンジニアでインフラの設計・構築をさせてもらっていました。まだ、海外のゲームが一部オンライン対応している頃の時代、オンラインゲームという言葉も一般的ではなかった状況でしたが、徐々にインターネットが普及し始め、ネットワークエンジニアをやっていれば何時かはゲームに関われるだろうと思い、インフラエンジニア職になったのがキッカケです。
まだ当時は、コンテンツとネットワークには線引きがあるようなイメージがあるなか、国内初の大型MMORPGである「ファイナルファンタジーXI」を運営していたスクウェア・エニックスは、ゲーム業界で唯一、全てのインフラを自社で用意し、コンテンツでインターネット業界を引っ張れる企業でした。前職は、国内有数の大手キャリアではありましたが、スクエニには遜色ない規模のインフラ/設備がそろっていたのと、システムの規模もさることながら、それをITベンダー/SIerを用いず自前で運営できているITスキルの高さが際立っていたのを覚えています。
そういった部分に魅力を感じたのか、私も含めてインフラエンジニアは殆どが転職組です。私のようにゲーム業界以外にも、SIerや金融系のデータベース経験者など、様々な経歴のエンジニアが活躍しています。ゲーム開発はチーム作業でもあるので、クライアントワークを経験している人のほうが現場にはなじみやすいかもしれません。サービスを止められないなかで、不具合の対処法を考える必要があるため、金融やECのインフラ構築経験なども応用できると思います。

The Manager, Direct Sales Global IP and Merchandise (GIP&MD) is responsible for planning and executing events, pop-up shops, as well as the launch of owned stores across European territories. # Principal Contaminant Hydrogeologist / Groundwater Modeller | Energy Sector
## High Wycombe, GBR
Contaminated land and groundwater modelling at the highest technical level requires more than strong analytical skills. It requires professional judgement to navigate complex, high-stakes decisions, the communication skills to translate that complexity into clear advice, and the leadership to guide both projects and people in the right direction.
At Stantec, our Energy and Resources Group is looking for a Principal Contaminant Hydrogeologist and Groundwater Modeller to bring exactly that combination to a growing, collaborative team. If you have built significant experience in contaminated site assessment, groundwater modelling and regulatory engagement, and you are ready for a role where your technical authority genuinely shapes outcomes, this is the opportunity.
**About The Role**
Based in Edinburgh, Glasgow, High Wycombe, Birmingham or Shrewsbury, you will take a leading technical role across complex contaminated land, hydrogeology and groundwater modelling projects spanning energy, infrastructure, industrial and regulated-sector clients.
You will act as technical lead on demanding projects, provide technical review and quality assurance, guide modelling strategy and support risk-based decision-making across a varied and challenging portfolio. You will design ground and hydrogeological investigations, develop, review and apply conceptual, analytical and numerical groundwater flow and contaminant transport models, and prepare and technically review hydrogeological risk assessments and contaminated land reports.
Beyond the technical work, you will mentor colleagues, contribute to service development and support the continued growth of a team that is ambitious about where it is heading. A willingness to travel to UK offices and project sites is required. Your desirable experience may include groundwater flow modelling using packages such as MODFLOW, FEFLOW or Visual MODFLOW; aquifer test design, supervision and interpretation; groundwater remediation options appraisal and remedial strategy development; environmental permitting and regulatory liaison; and hydrogeological risk assessment for industrial, energy, infrastructure, waste, nuclear or regulated sites.
**Your Impact**
The technical leadership you provide here will underpin how some of the most complex contaminated site and groundwater challenges in the UK are understood, assessed and resolved. Your conceptual models, risk assessments and modelling work will inform decisions that protect groundwater resources, support regulatory compliance and deliver remediation outcomes that leave environments in a genuinely better condition.
The colleagues you mentor, and the technical standards you help set, will shape the team's capabilities long after individual projects are complete. At the principal level, that kind of influence is one of the most enduring parts of the role.
**About You**
You hold a degree in Hydrogeology, Geology, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemistry or a related discipline, with a relevant MSc or PhD, which is a valuable addition. You bring significant experience in hydrogeology, contaminated land assessment, groundwater risk assessment and environmental consultancy, ideally within a consulting environment.
You have demonstrable capability in conceptual site model development, groundwater flow and contaminant transport modelling, and the assessment and consolidation of complex chemical and geological datasets. You review and prepare technical reports to a high standard, communicate complex findings clearly to clients, regulators and project teams, and bring the professional judgement that high-consequence work demands.
You are a collaborative, considered technical leader who is as motivated to develop the people around you as you are to solve difficult groundwater problems.

# Senior Contaminant Hydrogeologist / Groundwater Modeller | Energy Sector
## Glasgow, GBR
Understanding how contaminants move through the ground and interact with groundwater systems is some of the most technically demanding work in environmental consultancy. It requires sharp analytical thinking, genuine hydrogeological expertise and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to clients and regulators who depend on getting it right.
At Stantec, our Energy and Resources Group delivers exactly that kind of work across major energy, infrastructure, industrial and regulated-sector projects. We are looking for a Contaminant Hydrogeologist and Groundwater Modeller with extensive experience to join a strong, collaborative and growing team. If you are ready for a role where your technical depth is genuinely valued, and your career has real room to develop, we would love to hear from you.
**About The Role**
You will be based in Edinburgh, Glasgow, High Wycombe, Birmingham or Shrewsbury, joining a team that works holistically across contaminated land, hydrogeology, groundwater modelling and ground engineering.
Your work will span the full project lifecycle: field investigation design, groundwater monitoring, hydrogeological interpretation, risk assessment, numerical and analytical modelling, and technical reporting. You will develop, refine and apply conceptual site models for soil, groundwater, surface water and ground gas assessment, and contribute to groundwater flow and contaminant fate and transport modelling across a varied portfolio of contaminated site projects.
You will liaise directly with clients and regulators, prepare hydrogeological and contaminated land risk assessments, and mentor junior colleagues as the team continues to grow. A willingness to travel to UK offices and project sites is required.
**Your Impact**
The conceptual models and risk assessments you produce will directly inform how contaminated sites are understood, managed and remediated. Your technical judgement will help clients navigate regulatory processes with confidence, protect groundwater resources and deliver outcomes that leave land and water environments in a genuinely better condition.
The support you provide to junior colleagues will shape how the next generation of hydrogeologists in the team develops, building the kind of practical, grounded expertise that only comes from working alongside someone who has done it properly.
**About You**
You hold a degree in Hydrogeology, Geology, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemistry or a related discipline, with a relevant MSc or PhD, a welcome bonus though not essential. You bring years of relevant experience in hydrogeology, contaminated land assessment, groundwater risk assessment or environmental consultancy, ideally within a consulting environment.
Your technical toolkit includes experience in conceptual site model development, groundwater flow and contaminant transport modelling, ground investigation design, and the assessment and consolidation of chemical and geological datasets. You prepare clear, well-structured technical reports and communicate findings confidently to clients, regulators and multidisciplinary project teams. Experience with ArcGIS would be a useful addition.
You are comfortable working across complex, multi-faceted projects, contributing your expertise within collaborative teams and bringing the sound judgement that high-stakes contaminated land and groundwater work demands.

Facility end-users

Design teams and product specifiers

A credible and measurable pipeline is established across the current solutions portfolio.
Priority facility end-users, contractors, consultants and specifiers recognise Purever as a trusted data centre solutions provider.

Strong credibility with facility end-users, contractors, consultants, engineers, architects and product specifiers.

Strong technical understanding and the ability to explain solution performance, integration considerations and customer value.
Demonstrated capability in key account development, specification sales, pipeline management, forecasting and delivery against budget.
Commercial judgement to assess market scale, prioritise opportunities and shape routes to market.
The flexibility to adopt and sell new complementary solutions as the portfolio develops.
An international outlook and willingness to travel.

Dematic is a global leader in intelligent intralogistics and automated material handling solutions, delivering large-scale warehouse automation systems for some of the world’s leading brands. For decades, we’ve been redefining supply chains through innovation and cutting-edge automation technologies. We are looking for an OT Cybersecurity Compliance Lead who will be responsible for driving the cybersecurity of the operational technology (OT) systems delivered within the EMEA region. This covers Dematic systems throughout their lifecycle – from solution design and engineering to commissioning, handover and ongoing operation. You will work closely with project teams, solution engineering, customers and suppliers to embed security by design, manage cyber risk, and ensure that delivered automation systems meet customer requirements, company standards and applicable regulations. As the OT Cybersecurity Compliance Lead, you will drive, monitor and report on the compliance of OT systems with the EU Cyber Resilience Act and the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, and apply ISA/IEC 62443 across projects in order to prevent, mitigate and / or detect cyber risks to delivered systems. You will be responsible for system-level security architecture, assurance and documentation within dedicated projects – a scope distinct from corporate IT security and from product-level cybersecurity, which are owned by separate functions.
# **Det tilbyder vi:**
* Career Development
* Competitive Compensation And Benefits
* Pay Transparency
* Global Opportunities

**Italy:** €55,125 - €80,850 (Compensation will be aligned with the applicable National Collective Labour Agreement, namely the CBA , Metalmeccanico Industria)
**Lithuania:** €54,000 - €79,200
Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills.
# **Om dig:**
**What you'll be responsible for:**
* **Regulatory Compliance (Cyber Resilience Act & Machinery Regulation):**
+ Translate the EU Cyber Resilience Act and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 cybersecurity requirements into practical, auditable engineering and project requirements for OT systems.
+ Maintain readiness for the regulatory milestones (CRA vulnerability/incident reporting from September 2026 and full application December 2027; Machinery Regulation from January 2027).
+ Demonstrate system-level conformity where both regimes apply, reusing product-level assurance and closing the remaining integration gaps.
* **Secure-by-Design across the Project Lifecycle:**
+ Embed OT cybersecurity into the project lifecycle as gated, repeatable activities from design and engineering through FAT/SAT, commissioning and handover.
+ Author and review security requirements, architecture and risk assessments for bids and live projects, and advise project and solution teams.
+ Produce handover security documentation and the operations and maintenance security baseline inherited by the customer and Dematic Service.
* **OT Systems & Standards (IEC 62443):**
+ Apply ISA/IEC 62443 across OT systems – zones and conduits, network segmentation, secure remote access, hardening, patch and backup strategy.
+ Define reference architectures, hardening standards and reusable security building blocks so projects start from a compliant baseline.
* **Risk, Assurance and Testing:**
+ Conduct OT-specific risk assessments, security testing and assurance reviews; track findings and mitigations to closure across projects and the installed base.
+ Support OT security incident readiness and response for delivered systems, in coordination with IT Security and the customer.​
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
+ Act as the OT cybersecurity point of contact for project, engineering, quality, legal/compliance and customer stakeholders.
+ Provide guidance and training to project teams on OT security requirements and expectations.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
+ Capture lessons learned and feed them back into standards, reference designs and training.
+ Help build Dematic's OT cybersecurity capability so it scales with the project pipeline.
* **Compliance:**
+ Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, regulations and company policies.
+ Participate in internal and external audits as required.

* Proven ability to write and produce technical and compliance reports.
* Experience embedding cybersecurity into the project and engineering lifecycle.
* Ability to oversee internal and external security and compliance audits.

**About Stora**
Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses.
Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated.
In just over five years, Stora has grown from an early-stage product into a platform used by more than 500 operators.
We’re a product-led, remote-first company with an experienced engineering team and ambitious plans for what comes next.
Now, as the engineering organisation grows, we’re hiring an Engineering Manager to make sure the way we lead, develop and support engineers grows with it.
**The Role**
This is a genuine people leadership role.
You’ll manage approximately 12 engineers working across three product teams, with the team expected to continue growing.
Each product team has a Tech Lead responsible for technical direction, alongside Product and Design. Your focus is different: **the engineers themselves.**
This isn’t a role for somebody looking to move away from engineering completely, though. You’ll need enough technical depth to understand the work, follow engineering discussions and ask good questions without needing to be the person making every technical decision.
You’ll work closely with our Head of Engineering and have support from People, but you’ll have meaningful autonomy to improve how engineering management works at Stora.
**What Else You’ll Own**
**Engineering Management**
* Manage engineers across multiple product teams through regular, useful 1:1s, coaching and clear feedback.
* Make expectations clear and help engineers understand what good performance looks like.
* Identify performance issues early and handle difficult conversations properly when needed.
* Support engineers in progressing from junior through senior and beyond.
* Build strong relationships with engineers without creating unnecessary management overhead.
**Performance & Progression**
* Own the engineering performance and progression approach.
* Review and improve our existing career levels, expectations and review processes.
* Make promotion and progression decisions that are consistent, evidence-based and understood by the team.
* Create a culture where feedback happens throughout the year rather than being saved for formal reviews.
**Hiring & Team Development**
* Own engineering hiring alongside the relevant Tech Leads and wider team.
* Help define what we need before a search begins, assess candidates properly and maintain a high hiring bar.
* Ensure new engineers have a structured and useful onboarding experience.
* Think proactively about team composition, capability gaps and future hiring needs.
**Team Health**
* Pay attention to engagement, retention, collaboration and emerging people issues across the engineering organisation.
* Work with Tech Leads when team problems sit somewhere between technical delivery, behaviour and team dynamics.
* Help maintain a strong remote engineering culture as Stora grows.
**Technical Context**
* Stay close enough to the engineering work to understand what the team is solving and the environment they’re working within.
* Be comfortable reading code, following pull requests and participating intelligently in technical conversations.
* Partner with Tech Leads without competing with them for technical ownership.
**What Success Looks Like**
After your first year, we’d expect:
* Engineers to have a clear understanding of what is expected of them and how they can progress.
* Managers and engineers to be having better, more useful conversations about performance and development.
* Performance issues to be addressed early rather than becoming surprises.
* A progression framework that works for the engineering organisation Stora has become, not the company we were several years ago.
* Stronger and more consistent hiring and onboarding.
* The Head of Engineering spending less time acting as the default people manager for the entire engineering organisation.
**What We’re Looking For**
We’re looking for an **experienced Engineering Manager**, rather than somebody taking their first step into management.
You’ll ideally have:
* Previous experience directly managing software engineers across more than one team or product area.
* A strong track record of developing engineers at different stages of their careers.
* Hands-on experience managing performance, including difficult or underperformance situations.
* Experience making promotion and progression decisions.
* Experience running or improving engineering career frameworks, review cycles or progression processes.
* Previous experience hiring software engineers and building effective interview processes.
* An engineering background that allows you to understand code and contribute meaningfully to technical conversations.
* The judgement to know when to get involved and when to leave technical decisions with the Tech Leads.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in a remote environment.
* A practical understanding of how AI tools are changing software engineering and experience using them in your own work.
Experience with Ruby or Rails would be useful, but it isn’t essential.
We’re much more interested in whether you can **lead engineers well**.
**What This Role Isn’t**
It’s worth being clear that this isn’t:
* a Tech Lead role with some people management added on;
* a delivery or project management position;
* a Product Manager role;
* a hands-on engineering role where you’ll spend most of your week writing production code;
* a first Engineering Manager opportunity.
Technical leadership already exists within the product teams.
We’re hiring you because **engineering management itself deserves dedicated ownership.**
**Our Technology**
You won’t be expected to spend most of your time writing production code, but you should be comfortable working around our stack.
**Backend:** Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, TimescaleDB
**Frontend:** Turbo, React, ViewComponents, Sass
**Testing:** Minitest, Playwright
**Deployment:** GitHub Actions, Heroku

job_description:
Tesla is seeking an exceptional engineer with a strong understanding of aerodynamic design to strengthen the Thermal Systems group. Thermal management is a key factor in many of the attributes that make Tesla vehicles redefine the automotive world. To achieve fast charging, unrivaled range, ludicrous performance, exceptional cabin comfort and low running costs relies on a deep understanding and careful manipulation of the underlying physical principals. You will be responsible for developing the fluid dynamics aspects of our ground-breaking powertrain thermal management and HVAC systems in a fast-paced multi-disciplinary environment. and other flow behaviors
* Strong understanding of the strengths, weaknesses and limitations of the tools that are used for

or validate simulation/test results

* Experience in various types of CFD simulations including RANS, LES, VOF, DEM, CHT and their

* MS or PhD in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering; or the equivalent in experience and evidence

job_description:
**What to Expect**
This is a high-agency, hands-on role where you will own the systems architecture for Tesla's interior systems - including lighting, switches, and sensing - spanning power, controls, and signals. You will serve as the technical anchor across a
multi-disciplinary team encompassing mechanical design, materials, kinematics, low voltage electronics, software, functional safety, optical design, haptics, sensing, reliability, and functional validation. The role demands the ability
to translate complex system interactions into clear, safety-first architectures and actionable requirements. You will define system-level interfaces, drive cross-functional trade-offs, and ensure architectural coherence from concept through production launch. Beyond the desk, you will develop and mentor engineering talent both internally and at supplier partners, build and cultivate a world-class supplier base, and serve as the integrating force that ensures every subsystem works in harmony to deliver world-class interior systems. This role is based out of our Tesla Engineering, Shanghai facility and
will require close collaboration with global Tesla engineering teams.
**What You'll Do**
* Define and own the end-to-end systems architecture for interior systems including power distribution, control strategies, and signal routing across all interior subsystems.
* Lead discussions and facilitate trade-off analyses among engineers spanning electrical, mechanical, firmware, manufacturing, and functional safety domains.
* Develop and maintain system block diagrams, signal flow diagrams, and interface control documents (ICDs) that define the boundaries and interactions between mechanical, electrical, optical, and software subsystems.
* Lead the development of system-level DFMEA, HARA, and functional safety analyses including ASIL decomposition, functional safety concepts (FSC), and technical safety concepts (TSC) in accordance with ISO 26262.
* Ensure system architectures are compliant with applicable regulatory standards including ECE regulations and FMVSS requirements, and drive compliance considerations into early-phase design decisions.
* Architect systems with a deep understanding of mechanical and kinematic/dynamic principles including load paths, linkage design, and mechanism behavior under real-world operating conditions.
* Drive cross-functional decision-making that bridges mechanical design, low voltage electronics, firmware, optical, haptics, and validation disciplines to deliver the optimal balance of form, function, performance, and cost.
* Apply systems engineering principles to decompose high-level vehicle objectives into quantifiable system-level requirements with full traceability using tools such as Polarion or DOORS.
* Develop and manage a supplier base capable of executing complex interior systems. Direct supplier engineering development, conduct design reviews, and ensure suppliers meet Tesla's architectural intent and quality standards.
* Mentor and develop engineering talent internally and at supplier partners, fostering first-principles thinking and systems-level problem solving across the team.
* Follow a V-model systems development lifecycle from requirements definition through system integration, verification, and validation, collaborating closely with validation and reliability engineers to ensure architecture decisions are testable and meet durability targets.
* Maintain all required product development documentation and manage requirements, issues, and program execution using JIRA and Polarion.

About this job
Introducing The Insights Family
The Insights Family exists to know what kids and families do next. Since 2017 we have listened to kids, young adults and parents at a scale no one else can match: close to a million people a year across 22 markets, more than 5.5 billion data points and counting. We are not a panel you dust off once a year. We are an always-on instrument, and the world's leading media, entertainment, toy, licensing, advertising and consumer brands use us to replace guesswork with independent, real-time evidence. Kids sway 78% of family spending, yet most decisions about the trillion-dollar family economy are still made on assumption and instinct. The kid sets the agenda; the parent makes it real, and our job is to put their real voice into the rooms where the biggest decisions get made. Our next chapter is about scale: deepening our footprint across EMEA and accelerating growth in the US from our locations in Manchester, London and New York. If you want to help define a category rather than follow one, this is the place to do it. **Our Culture and Values** As a growing business, ensuring we are all committed to our core values is vital to creating the culture we all want to work within and establishes the foundations for high performance and growth. The core values we crafted as a team: • Accountable: Embracing ownership across all aspects of our business, including actions, decisions, and outcomes, and willingly taking responsibility for the results we achieve. • Inquisitive: Having a strong desire to learn, explore, and ask questions, and being curious about finding new solutions and opportunities. • Collaborative: Working together as a team, fostering a cooperative environment, and leveraging collective expertise to achieve shared goals. • Data-Driven: Relying on evidence, analytics, and insights to guide decision-making and drive our strategies. • Supportive: Providing assistance, encouragement, and resources to team members, customers, and partners, fostering a supportive and nurturing environment. • Empowered: Encouraging individuals to take ownership of their work, providing them with the autonomy and resources needed to make impactful decisions and drive innovation. • Customer-First: Putting customers' needs and satisfaction at the forefront of business decisions and strategies, prioritising their success and providing exceptional experiences and value.
About the role
A lot of companies treat customer success as a help desk. Answer the question, run the quarterly review, hope the renewal comes in. We see it differently. Our customers pay us for answers about kids and families, so every question they ask tells us something about what they are trying to do next, and nobody at TIF hears more of those questions than this role. You will look after your own portfolio of customers, and you will own all of it: the relationship, the renewal and the growth. The day-to-day support matters and we want it done brilliantly, but the job does not stop when the query is answered. If a customer asks about one market, show them what the data says about the next one. If half their team never logs in, find out why. When you spot a way we could be more useful to a customer, that is your opening, and often our next piece of revenue. To be clear, this is a growth role. You will carry a number for the accounts you look after, and we will measure you on retention and expansion, not on how many tickets you close. It suits someone who genuinely likes customers and likes selling, and who would rather bring a customer an idea than wait for renewal season. The role covers five areas: **Portfolio Ownership & Growth Planning**• Own the end-to-end relationship for a portfolio of named accounts, from onboarding through adoption, renewal and growth, with responsibility for the portfolio's growth revenue: upsell, cross-sell, seat growth and tier upgrades. • Build account growth plans tied to each customer's business outcomes, and forecast your expansion pipeline with sales-level rigour. • Work with the VP Customer Success, Sales and CEO on account priorities, mapping stakeholders and building multi-threaded relationships with economic buyers, not just day-to-day users. **Insight-Led Support & Findings** • Own day-to-day customer queries and treat every one as an intent signal: resolve it quickly and well, then bring back what else the data shows. • Work with Research Solutions to turn TIF data into proactive, account-relevant findings that open the next value conversation. • Make support visible and repeatable: log every touch, spot patterns in what customers ask, and feed them into product and commercial conversations. **Adoption, Health & Whitespace** • Live in our portal usage data and customer health signals to spot whitespace, adoption gaps and risk early, and help shape how we measure customer health across all accounts. • Partner with Sales on handoffs and kick-offs, then lead onboarding of new accounts with clear first-90-day value milestones that shorten time-to-value. • Drive adoption of new TIF products as they launch, including Trackers, Custom Audiences, the API and our customer AI Agent, meeting customers where they are. **Commercial Conversations & Renewals** • Lead renewal conversations early and commercially, negotiating value and impact, not just avoiding churn. • Deliver Quarterly and Executive Business Reviews that make the quantified case for expanded investment. • Convert findings into qualified expansion opportunities and carry them through to close, contributing to team-wide Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by flagging risk early and supporting peers. **Proof, Advocacy & Referral** • Turn customer impact into proof: capture referenceable stories and quantified outcomes every quarter, feeding marketing, the website and the sales team. • Borrow trust: identify referral opportunities that generate new business leads for our sales team. • Track every engagement and outcome in the CRM so activity is visible, attributable and repeatable.
What success looks like
• By 90 days: Your portfolio is mapped with growth plans for your priority accounts, you are on top of usage and health signals, and your first proactive findings have landed with customers. • By 6 months: A steady rhythm of insight-led business reviews, renewals engaged early with no surprises, and a growing expansion pipeline with your first growth revenue closed. • By 12 months: Portfolio NRR ahead of target, a documented playbook for turning findings into revenue, and a bank of referenceable customer stories the whole business trades on. **What You'll Bring** • Commercially sharp with a proven quota-carrying or growth-revenue history; three-plus years in a CS, AM or hybrid sales-CS role. • Data-fluent: confident interrogating datasets and insight platforms, and turning what you find into commercial narratives and ROI stories for senior, non-technical buyers. • Structured account planning across a portfolio, with the negotiation skills to sell value and impact. • Early risk and opportunity detection from usage and churn signals, combined with confident forecasting and pipeline management; expansion pipeline, not just renewals. • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, confident with senior stakeholders in writing, on calls and in the room. • Self-motivated and resilient under ambiguity and growth targets; a scaleup environment where you wear multiple hats. • Your curiosity default is tuned to 'what else', 'what now', 'how can I go faster'.
Bonus Points

# MARKETING LEAD

# **WE ARE STORY ENGINEERS.**
The Bayeux Tapestry at the British Museum. The David Bowie Centre at V&A East Storehouse. The Formula 1 Exhibition. Harry Potter: The Exhibition. TOCA Social. Nearly thirty years of experiences designed and delivered to wow audiences on opening night and keep working every day for years afterwards.
We work at the intersection of storytelling and technology, transforming museums, exhibitions, stadiums and cultural spaces into unforgettable journeys. We design, deliver and install experiences that not only leave lasting impressions for audiences but also give our clients outstanding value, smooth delivery, and the confidence that their creative vision will be fully realised. We call it Story Engineering: a discipline built around the story, not the specification. The name is new, we rebranded from Sysco Productions this year. The work isn’t. What we’ve been missing is someone whose job is making sure the right people know about it.
## ROLE
This role is part-time, three days a week, three shorter days across five if that suits you better. We’re flexible on shape, not on the calibre of person we’re looking for. Built for someone with real experience who isn’t looking to work full-time
This role exists to grow the top of our pipeline.
We’ve just rebranded, and the groundwork behind it is substantial: audience insights, brand strategy, tone of voice, website architecture and copy, brand archetypes, a mapped view of which markets to prioritise next. The strategy is sound. What it needs now is someone to make it produce opportunities.
The Marketing Lead reads the pieces already in place, proposes what happens next and in what order, and turns an agreed direction into campaigns, content, and the pipeline intelligence that business development runs on. The exec signs off on direction and priorities, but getting there starts with this person looking at what we’ve built and making the case for where to focus. That judgement – knowing what to prioritise inside an existing strategy, rather than inventing one from scratch – is what the role asks for.
Be clear on the shape of it: this is a hands-on job, not a budget-holding one. Marketing spend is modest and made case by case. Most of what happens will happen because this person did it. There’s an in-house designer to work alongside, and real ownership on offer, but the work gets made rather than delegated.
Within the first six to twelve months, this looks like: a website that carries a genuinely finished, on-brand content set; audience intelligence feeding every business development conversation, not just sitting in a CRM; two or three thought leadership pieces live, written with our own people; and a first, tested view of which new markets are actually worth the weight.
## RESPONSIBILITIES
* **Grows the top of the funnel.** Turns brand and audience work into qualified interest – measured in conversations started and opportunities created, not impressions.
* **Runs the marketing engine.** Owns the content calendar, social presence, and website updates, working alongside our in-house designer day to day. Writes and publishes copy, briefs and reviews visual assets, and keeps the machine moving without needing to be chased.
* **Owns tone of voice.** Knows the guidelines well enough to write to them without thinking and to spot, on sight, when something doesn’t sound like us – whether that’s their own draft, someone else’s, or an agency’s. Champions the standard everywhere words leave the building.
* **Opens up new markets**. Uses the existing audience and market prioritisation work to build presence in the sectors we’re expanding into, testing what lands before committing weight to it.
* **Develops thought leadership.** Puts our own people’s expertise into the world through articles and long-form content – building the briefs and frameworks that make it easy for busy technical and delivery leads to contribute, not just asking them to write.
* **Continues the website build.** Sitemap, wireframe, and copy archetypes are already in place, with pages partway through being populated against them. Directs that work through to completion, extends it using the existing specification, and keeps the site current once it’s live.
* **Builds audience intelligence.** Runs email campaigns, tracks engagement, and builds a working picture of who’s warm, who’s cold, and who’s ready for a conversation – handing that intelligence to business development.
* **Owns the marketing system.** Develops the CRM and marketing data setup incrementally, in line with the wider commercial model, rather than treating it as someone else’s infrastructure.
* **Keeps us in the conversation.** Watches for relevant trade press, industry publications, and conference opportunities, and joins the live conversation when our projects come up on social media – timely engagement, not a scheduled campaign.
* **Reports on what’s working.** Provides regular, plain-English updates on campaign performance and pipeline impact – not vanity metrics, results that connect back to opportunities.
## WHAT YOU’LL BRING
* **Judgement inside a strategy.** You read a strategy document and see a to-do list, not a mystery. You can look at what’s already there, work out what matters most right now, make a clear case for it, and then go and build it yourself.
* **Commercial instinct.** Healthy scepticism about vanity metrics and a habit of connecting marketing activity back to pipeline and revenue, even when no one’s asked you to.
* **Writing**. Properly. Clean, on-brand copy without much hand-holding, and you can read someone else’s and know instantly when it’s off.
* **Real ownership, already.** You’ve run marketing somewhere before, not just contributed to it – five years or more, with at least some of that owning a channel mix and living with the results.
* **B2B services marketing is a strong fit, not a requirement.** You’ve marketed a services business to other businesses, or you’ve got the underlying instincts – long sales cycles, high-value clients, considered buying decisions – even if the sector’s new to you.
* **Fluency in the tools.** WordPress, a CRM and email platform, and enough analytics and SEO literacy to read what’s happening and not break what’s been set up.
* **Generosity with what you know.** Working alongside less experienced colleagues, explaining your thinking rather than just doing the thing yourself, comes naturally.
* **Sector knowledge is optional.** Experience in technology, events, or experience delivery isn’t required. The sector knowledge is learnable; the judgement isn’t.
## JOB DETAILS
* **Title:** Marketing Lead
* **Reports to:** The Exec Team
* **Employment:** Part-time, around three days a week (flexible across up to five shorter days), with more time needed in the first few months
* **Location:** Hybrid / Home Working / Sussex Barn, Godalming.

### Technical Leadership
* Lead the design, development and delivery of data products and pipelines.
* Set engineering standards covering architecture, coding, testing, code review, CI/CD and deployment.
* Take technical accountability for the solutions delivered by the team.
* Establish scalable, repeatable and supportable engineering patterns.

* Translate business requirements into impactful data products.
* Assess business readiness and ensure data products drive meaningful action.
* Analyse insights and trends to identify opportunities to improve business performance.

* Mentor data engineers across the team and wider engineering community.
* Review technical work and provide engineering direction.
* Help develop capabilities in areas where the organisation needs deeper expertise.
* Create opportunities for engineers to progress professionally.

* Demonstrable experience leading a data engineering team or workstream.
* Experience setting technical direction and reviewing other engineers' work.
* Strong stakeholder and user engagement experience.
* Experience working with large datasets, data mining, data profiling and ETL development.

* dbt
* Data transformation and ETL

* CI/CD for data pipelines

* Microsoft Power BI
* Tableau

National Grid is looking for someone who can combine strong technical capability with commercial and operational awareness.
